rows.source: Slurred eighths
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Your fourth finger
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · title

rows.source: A whole step above third
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fourth finger reaches a whole step above third. On the D string that's A, the same note as the open A string. Keep the finger curved and let your hand lean toward it.
rows.translation: Fjärde fingret når ett heltonssteg över tredje. På D-strängen är det A, samma ton som öppen A-sträng. Håll fingret böjt och låt handen luta mot det.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fourth-finger A on the D string, open A, then fourth finger again. Match them exactly.
rows.translation: A med fjärde fingret på D-strängen, öppet A, sedan fjärde fingret igen. Matcha dem exakt.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Why use fourth finger instead of an open string?
rows.translation: Varför använda fjärde fingret i stället för en öppen sträng?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It avoids a string crossing and sounds warmer
rows.translation: Det undviker strängbyte och låter varmare
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It's always louder
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Open strings are out of tune
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fingered note keeps the line on one string and blends with the notes around it. Open strings ring brighter.
rows.translation: En nedtryckt ton håller melodin på en sträng och smälter in bland tonerna omkring. Öppna strängar klingar ljusare.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Third-finger D, fourth-finger E on the A string, then open E. Listen for the match.
rows.translation: D med tredje fingret, E med fjärde på A-strängen, sedan öppet E. Lyssna efter samma ton.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D to A on one string
rows.translation: D till A på en sträng
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Lightly Row on one string
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A slow hymn tune
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Amazing Grace is sung to an early American tune called New Britain. Its pairs of quick notes are slurs. Let the long notes sing with full, slow bows.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace sjungs till en tidig amerikansk melodi som heter New Britain. De snabba tonparen är bundna. Låt de långa tonerna sjunga med hela, långsamma stråk.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G to B and back crosses strings. Rock smoothly from the elbow.
rows.translation: G till B och tillbaka byter sträng. Gunga mjukt från armbågen.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How do you bow a quick pair, like B to G?
rows.translation: Hur stryker du ett snabbt par, som B till G?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Both notes in one bow
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: One bow for each note
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: They're slurred, so they share one bow.
rows.translation: De är bundna, så de delar ett stråk.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Second phrase
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Getting ready for vibrato
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · title

rows.source: What vibrato is
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Vibrato is a small, even wave in pitch that makes long notes glow. The fingertip rolls slightly back from the note and returns, again and again, moved by the hand and arm.
rows.translation: Vibrato är en liten, jämn våg i tonhöjden som får långa toner att glöda. Fingertoppen rullar lite bakåt från tonen och tillbaka, om och om igen, med handens och armens rörelse.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In tune comes first
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Vibrato can't rescue a note that's out of tune; it only colors one that's centered. Most players add it once their fingers land in tune without searching.
rows.translation: Vibrato kan inte rädda en falsk ton; det färgar bara en ton som redan är centrerad. De flesta lägger till det när fingrarna landar rent utan att leta.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When is a note ready for vibrato?
rows.translation: När är en ton redo för vibrato?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: When it's already in tune
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: When it's a little sharp
rows.translation: När den är lite för hög
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: When the bow moves fast
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A first motion, no bow
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Set second finger on the A string. Keep the fingertip in place, soften the knuckle, and slowly rock your hand toward the scroll and back. Small and even. A teacher's eye helps here.
rows.translation: Sätt andra fingret på A-strängen. Håll fingertoppen på plats, mjuka upp knogen och gunga långsamt handen mot snäckan och tillbaka. Litet och jämnt. En lärares blick hjälper här.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Now bow these without vibrato and center each one. That center is where vibrato starts.
rows.translation: Stryk nu dessa utan vibrato och centrera varje ton. Där börjar vibratot.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Long, centered tones
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Fiddle slurs
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler was in print by 1847. Fiddlers slur its quickest notes in pairs, which gives the tune its skip. Start slow and keep the pairs even.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler fanns i tryck senast 1847. Spelmän binder de snabbaste tonerna parvis, vilket ger melodin dess studs. Börja långsamt och håll paren jämna.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First part, ending
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Why do fiddlers slur quick pairs?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It saves bow and adds a lilt
rows.translation: Det sparar stråke och ger svikt
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It makes every note louder
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It keeps the strings in tune
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A, G, F sharp, A on the E string: third finger, low 2, first, third.
rows.translation: A, G, Fiss, A på E-strängen: tredje fingret, lågt 2, första, tredje.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Recital: Ode to Joy
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · title

rows.source: Your recital
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put it all together: in-tune fingers, straight bows, slurs and dynamics. Start piano, grow through the middle, and finish forte.
rows.translation: Sätt ihop allt: rena fingrar, raka stråk, bindningar och dynamik. Börja piano, väx genom mitten och avsluta forte.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Warm up: fourth finger against the open strings, A and then E.
rows.translation: Värm upp: fjärde fingret mot öppna strängar, A och sedan E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which marking means grow louder?
rows.translation: Vilken beteckning betyder att bli starkare?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Ode to Joy, first half
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Ode to Joy, second half
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Sit, bow and play in tune, from open strings to The Swan
rows.translation: Sitt, stryk och spela rent, från öppna strängar till Svanen
rows.context: Cello course · course subtitle

rows.source: Hello, cello
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · title

rows.source: Sit, set the endpin, hold the bow, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Sitt, ställ in stackeln, håll stråken, spela öppna strängar och din första låt.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · unit summary

rows.source: Meet your cello
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · title

rows.source: From low to high the strings are C, G, D and A. C is the thickest and lowest. A is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Från lågt till högt är strängarna C, G, D och A. C är tjockast och lägst. A är tunnast och högst och kallas sträng 1.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string is the lowest?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
rows.translation: C är den tjockaste och lägsta strängen. Strängarna räknas från A (1) till C (4).
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Knäpp sträng 1, A, och låt den klinga.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now string 2, the D.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
rows.translation: Nu den tjockaste strängen, C. Låt den mullra.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sit with your cello
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · title

rows.source: Sit tall, near the edge
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
rows.translation: Sitt nära stolens framkant med fötterna plant och knäna isär, som om du lätt kunde resa dig. Cellon vilar mellan knäna.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Set the endpin
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
rows.translation: Dra ut stackeln tills cellons överkant möter bröstbenet och C-stämskruven är nära vänster öra. Dra åt skruven. Ett stackelstöd eller en rem hindrar den från att glida.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
rows.translation: Var rör cellons överkant vid dig?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Your chest, at the breastbone
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your left shoulder
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Under your chin
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
rows.translation: Cellon lutar bakåt mot bröstet och knäna stabiliserar lätt från sidorna.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
rows.translation: Sitt upprätt och knäpp D, sedan G. Håll axlarna avslappnade.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A round, heavy hand
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
rows.translation: Böj tummen och sätt toppen där froschen möter stången, mitt emot långfingret. Lägg alla fyra fingrar över stången och låt handen hänga tungt.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Sätt stråken på D-strängen mitt mellan stall och greppbräda. Dra långsamt åt höger.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Nu A-strängen. Flytta hela armen till dess nivå och dra sedan långsamt.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
rows.translation: Från lågt till högt: C, G, D, A. Varje sträng ligger fem bokstavsnamn över den förra, ett intervall som kallas kvint. Minnesregel: Cirkusens Glada Djur Arbetar.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
rows.translation: Höger arm avgör vilken sträng stråken spelar. Varje sträng har sin armnivå som trappsteg. Flytta hela armen, inte bara handen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
rows.translation: Stryk C-strängen, sedan G. Låt armen vila på varje nivå.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now D, then A.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Tune your cello
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · title

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
rows.translation: Orkestrar stämmer efter A. Timbre visar avståndet från varje sträng till rätt ton i cent; 100 cent är ett halvtonssteg, pianots minsta steg. Stäm A, sedan D, G och C.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Nu D, G och C. Stäm varje sträng, stryk den och håll tonen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Sitt upprätt med inställd stackel, mjukt stråkgrepp och stråken mitt mellan stall och greppbräda. Spela nu allt från enheten.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · challenge vc-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb ligger på D-strängen: öppet D, första fingret ett heltonssteg upp för E, tredje fingret två heltonssteg upp för Fiss. Knäpp först, stryk sedan.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
rows.translation: Första fingret på D-strängen, ett heltonssteg upp. Det är E.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Tredje fingret, ett heltonssteg över det första. Det är Fiss.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
rows.translation: Fiss, E, D, E, sedan Fiss tre gånger.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Ett långsamt nedstråk, sedan ett långsamt uppstråk på D. Håll ljudet jämnt ända till slutet.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Whole bows on D
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Quarters on D and A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: D, A, D, A. Låt armen gunga mellan de två nivåerna.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Your arm, changing levels
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Turning the cello
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Från C till D hoppar du över G-strängen, så armen gör en större rörelse. Rör dig mjukt utan att mellansträngen hörs.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First position: D and A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · title

rows.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
rows.translation: Ett finger per halvtonssteg: spela D-dur och dina första melodier.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · unit summary

rows.source: First finger: E
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · title

rows.source: One finger per half step
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
rows.translation: Ett halvtonssteg är musikens minsta steg. I första läget ligger fingrarna ett halvtonssteg isär, från ett heltonssteg (två halvtonssteg) över öppen sträng. Tummen bakom halsen, mitt emot andra fingret.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Öppet D, sedan E med första fingret. Håll E tills tonen är ren.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
rows.translation: Samma finger på A-strängen: öppet A, sedan B.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
rows.translation: Öppet D, sedan E. Hur långt isär?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: First finger on D and A
rows.translation: Första fingret på D och A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Third finger: F sharp
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · title

rows.source: Skip a finger
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
rows.translation: Tredje fingret spelar Fiss, ett heltonssteg över E. Låt andra fingret sväva över sin plats mellan 1 och 3 så att handen behåller formen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
rows.translation: D, E, Fiss. Håll första fingret nere medan tredje spelar.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Från E till nästa ton: vilket slags steg?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
rows.translation: Varför stannar andra fingret över sin plats?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It keeps the hand's spacing
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It plays F sharp
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It holds the cello up
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
rows.translation: Varje finger har ett halvtonssteg. Med alla fyra på plats landar varje ton på samma ställe varje gång.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
rows.translation: Samma fingrar på A-strängen: öppet A, B, Ciss.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fourth finger: G
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · title

rows.source: All four fingers
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Fjärde fingret spelar G, ett halvtonssteg över Fiss. D, E, Fiss, G är första halvan av D-durskalan: öppen, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G med fjärde fingret på D-strängen är en oktav över den öppna G-strängen: samma bokstav, åtta toner högre. När tonen är ren ljuder G-strängen med.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G med fjärde fingret, öppet G, sedan G med fjärde fingret igen. Lyssna efter medklangen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Spela D, E, Fiss, G på D-strängen, sedan A, B, Ciss, D på A-strängen. Samma fingrar två gånger: öppen, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
rows.translation: Vilka fingrar spelar D-dur på varje sträng?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Open, 1, 2, 3
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Open, 2, 3, 4
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
rows.translation: Den franska melodin från 1700-talet använder bara toner du lärt dig: D, E, Fiss, G på D-strängen och A och B på A-strängen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
rows.translation: Vilket finger spelar B på A-strängen?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Third, on the D string
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Second, on the D string
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: First, on the A string
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: D and A checkup
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · title

rows.source: Keep the frame
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Öppen, 1, 3, 4 på D- och A-strängarna. Behåll handformen, landa varje ton rent och låt oktaverna klinga.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Tredje fingret till fjärde: vilket slags steg?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
rows.translation: Två oktavkontroller: G med öppet G, sedan D med fjärde fingret mot öppet D.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
rows.translation: Vilket finger spelar Ciss på A-strängen?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G and C strings
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · title

rows.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
rows.translation: Två låga strängar, C-dur- och G-durskalor samt tre klassiska melodier.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · unit summary

rows.source: Same fingers, lower string
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
rows.translation: På G-strängen spelar första fingret A, tredje B och fjärde C. Samma avstånd som på D. Låt armen vila på G-strängens nivå.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G, A, B, C: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C på G-strängen plus D, E, Fiss, G på D-strängen bildar G-durskalan. Samma fingrar på båda strängarna.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
rows.translation: Vilket finger spelar C på G-strängen?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G major scale
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: The C string
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · title

rows.source: The deepest string
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
rows.translation: På C-strängen spelar första fingret D, tredje E och fjärde F. Den tjocka strängen behöver ett långsamt, tungt stråk för att ljuda.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F: öppen, 1, 3, 4. Ge varje ton tid att ljuda.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: C major, low octave
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F på C-strängen plus G, A, B, C på G-strängen blir C-durskalan. Den har inga kors alls.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
rows.translation: Uppför C-durskalan. Lyssna högst upp efter C som klingar med den öppna C-strängen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: C major scale
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Second finger: F natural
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · title

rows.source: Second finger joins in
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
rows.translation: Andra fingret spelar återställt F på D-strängen, ett halvtonssteg under Fiss, och återställt C på A-strängen. C-dur behöver båda.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
rows.translation: D, E, F, G: öppen, 1, 2, 4. Andra fingret sitter precis intill första.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: E, then second finger or third?
rows.translation: E, sedan andra eller tredje fingret?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Second: F natural
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Third: F sharp
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: One finger, one half step
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
rows.translation: Cellister ger varje finger ett halvtonssteg, så F tar andra fingret och Fiss tredje. En ton utanför handen, som Fiss på C-strängen, kräver en sträckning, en bredare hand. Kursen väljer tonarter som undviker det.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
rows.translation: C-dur, andra oktaven: andra fingret för F och det översta C.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: C major, two octaves
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
rows.translation: Ode till glädjen, en oktav upp
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Brahms' Lullaby
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · title

rows.source: A cradle song from 1868
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
rows.translation: Brahms skrev vaggvisan 1868. Den gungar i tretakt på G- och D-strängarna. Använd långa, långsamma stråk och låt varje fras andas.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
rows.translation: G, Fiss, E: finger 4, 3, 1. Det här är vaggvisans högsta punkt.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A French folk song
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
rows.translation: Au clair de la lune är en fransk folkvisa från 1700-talet. Den ligger på G- och D-strängarna med C under fjärde fingret.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
rows.translation: D, C, B, A, G: öppet D, sedan finger 4, 3, 1 och öppet G.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
rows.translation: Vilka toner i melodin är öppna strängar?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C and A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Traditional (France, 18th century)
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: Low strings checkup
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · title

rows.source: Four strings, one hand
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
rows.translation: Öppen, 1, 3, 4 på varje sträng, med andra fingret för återställt F och C. Långsamma, tunga stråk på de låga strängarna.

rows.source: D, E, then which finger?

rows.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
rows.translation: Glid till fjärde läget, kontrollera med örat och spela Svanen och Amazing Grace.

rows.source: Your first shift
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · title

rows.source: What a shift is
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
rows.translation: En lägesväxling flyttar hela handen till ett nytt ställe på strängen. Lätta på fingret, glid längs strängen utan att lyfta och låt tummen följa med handen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fourth position
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
rows.translation: I fjärde läget spelar första fingret D på A-strängen, tonen fjärde fingret spelade i första läget. Tummen vilar där halsen böjer in mot kroppen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
rows.translation: B med första fingret, glid sedan upp med det till D. Håll det lätt på vägen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What travels during a shift?
rows.translation: Vad rör sig vid en lägesväxling?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The whole hand, thumb included
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the finger
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the thumb
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
rows.translation: Att flytta handen som en enhet bevarar fingeravstånden så att även nästa toner landar rent.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
rows.translation: Växla upp, tillbaka och upp igen med första fingret. Landa varje ton rent.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fourth position on A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · title

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
rows.translation: I fjärde läget på A-strängen spelar första fingret D, tredje E och fjärde F. Samma handform som i första läget: ett finger per halvtonssteg.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
rows.translation: D, E, F: finger 1, 3, 4. Här uppe ligger tonerna lite tätare.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
rows.translation: Öppet A, B, växla med första fingret till D, sedan E med tredje.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
rows.translation: Vilket finger spelar E i fjärde läget på A-strängen?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Up to fourth position and back
rows.translation: Upp till fjärde läget och tillbaka

rows.source: Fourth position on D
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · title

rows.source: Check it with the open A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
rows.translation: I fjärde läget på D-strängen spelar första fingret G och tredje A, samma ton som öppen A-sträng. Spela dem efter varandra och matcha dem.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
rows.translation: G med första fingret, sedan A med tredje, båda på D-strängen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
rows.translation: A i fjärde läget, öppet A, A i fjärde läget. Gör dem till ett ljud.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Shift on the D string
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
rows.translation: Spela E med första fingret i första läget och glid sedan upp med det till G. Det är tre halvtonssteg, samma avstånd som B till D på A-strängen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
rows.translation: E med första fingret, glid sedan till G med samma finger. Låt tummen följa med.

rows.source: The Swan
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · title

rows.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
rows.translation: Svanen kommer från Djurens karneval, skriven av Camille Saint-Saëns 1886. Här är inledningsfrasen, en oktav lägre och förenklad.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A singing bow
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
rows.translation: Långa toner behöver långsamma stråk. Håll stråken nära stallet och fördela den jämnt så att varje ton varar ända till slutet utan att avta.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
rows.translation: G, Fiss, B: fjärde och tredje fingret på D, sedan tredje på G.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How do you keep a long note from fading?
rows.translation: Hur hindrar du en lång ton från att avta?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Spread the bow evenly
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In Amazing Grace, the high D comes right after open A. While the A rings, slide your hand up to fourth position and land on D with first finger.
rows.translation: I Amazing Grace kommer höga D direkt efter öppet A. Medan A klingar glider handen upp till fjärde läget och landar på D med första fingret.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B, open A, then first-finger D in fourth position. Move while the A sounds.
rows.translation: B, öppet A, sedan D med första fingret i fjärde läget. Flytta medan A ljuder.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: When is the easiest moment to shift?
rows.translation: När är det lättast att växla läge?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: During an open string
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In the middle of a long note
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Never; stretch instead
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: While an open string sounds, your left hand is free, so the shift can't be heard.
rows.translation: Medan en öppen sträng ljuder är vänsterhanden fri, så lägesväxlingen hörs inte.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Light, together, in tune
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lighten the finger, move hand and thumb together, and check where you land. The open strings will tell you if you're right.
rows.translation: Lätta på fingret, flytta hand och tumme tillsammans och kontrollera landningen. De öppna strängarna visar om det är rätt.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fourth-position A on the D string, then open A. Match them.
rows.translation: A i fjärde läget på D-strängen, sedan öppet A. Matcha dem.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In fourth position, which note does first finger play on the A string?
rows.translation: Vilken ton spelar första fingret på A-strängen i fjärde läget?

rows.source: From paired strings to fiddle tunes and the bluegrass chop
rows.translation: Från dubbla strängar till fiollåtar och bluegrasshugg
rows.context: Mandolin course · course subtitle

rows.source: Hello, mandolin
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 “Hello, mandolin” · title

rows.source: Meet the paired strings, tune them and play all four open notes.
rows.translation: Lär känna strängparen, stäm dem och spela alla fyra öppna toner.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 “Hello, mandolin” · unit summary

rows.source: Meet your mandolin
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · title

rows.source: Eight strings, four notes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A mandolin has eight strings in four pairs, called courses. The two strings of a pair are tuned to the same note and played together, so you treat each pair as one string.
rows.translation: En mandolin har åtta strängar i fyra par, så kallade körer. De två strängarna i ett par stäms till samma ton och spelas tillsammans, så du behandlar varje par som en sträng.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Counting the pairs
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The pair nearest your face is the lowest, pair 4. The pair nearest the floor is the highest, pair 1. When a lesson says string 3, it means the third pair.
rows.translation: Paret närmast ansiktet är lägst, par 4. Paret närmast golvet är högst, par 1. När en lektion säger sträng 3 menas det tredje paret.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you play a pair?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Both strings at once, as one note
rows.translation: Båda strängarna samtidigt, som en ton
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the thicker string
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: One string, then the other
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The two strings sit close together, so one pick stroke catches both. Together they ring as one fuller note.
rows.translation: De två strängarna ligger tätt, så ett plektrumanslag fångar båda. Tillsammans klingar de som en fylligare ton.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pick the lowest pair, pair 4, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Slå an lägsta paret, par 4, och låt det klinga.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the highest pair, pair 1.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Tune the pairs
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · title

rows.source: Two strings, one pitch
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each pair has to match the tuner and match itself. If its two strings disagree, you hear a slow wobble. Tune one string, then bring its partner to the same note.
rows.translation: Varje par måste stämma mot stämapparaten och sig självt. Om strängarna skiljer sig hör du en långsam svävning. Stäm en sträng och för sedan partnern till samma ton.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3, the D pair. Tune both strings until the wobble stops.
rows.translation: Par 3, D-paret. Stäm båda strängarna tills svävningen upphör.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now pair 2, the A pair.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: One pair has a slow wobble. What is wrong?
rows.translation: Ett par har en långsam svävning. Vad är fel?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Its two strings don't match
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The pick is too thick
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: You are pressing too hard
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: That wobble is called beating: the two strings are slightly apart. Tune them until it smooths out.
rows.translation: Det kallas svävning: de två strängarna ligger lite isär. Stäm dem tills ljudet blir jämnt.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Tune up to the note
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Loosen a little below the note, then tighten up to it. Approaching from below keeps the string from slipping flat later.
rows.translation: Lossa till lite under tonen och spänn sedan upp till den. Att närma sig underifrån hindrar strängen från att sjunka senare.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, then pair 1. Bring each string up to the note from below.
rows.translation: Par 4, sedan par 1. För varje sträng upp till tonen underifrån.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Hold the pick
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · title

rows.source: A relaxed pinch
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold the pick between the pad of your thumb and the side of your curled index finger. Let only the tip show. Keep your wrist loose, as if shaking water off your hand.
rows.translation: Håll plektrumet mellan tummens mjuka sida och sidan av det böjda pekfingret. Låt bara spetsen synas. Håll handleden lös, som när du skakar av vatten från handen.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How much of the pick should show?
rows.translation: Hur mycket av plektrumet ska synas?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Half of it
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Just the tip
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: As much as possible
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A short tip gives you control and a clean sound. Too much pick snags on the paired strings.
rows.translation: En kort spets ger kontroll och rent ljud. För mycket plektrum fastnar i de dubbla strängarna.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Down through the pair
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Push the pick down through both strings of a pair in one small motion and stop just past them. Rest the heel of your hand lightly near the bridge.
rows.translation: För plektrumet ned genom båda strängarna i paret med en liten rörelse och stanna precis efter dem. Vila handloven lätt nära stallet.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Four down, four down
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Two on each pair
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: From low to high, the pairs are G, D, A and E. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat. A violin is tuned the same way, so fiddle tunes sit naturally on a mandolin.
rows.translation: Från lågt till högt är paren G, D, A och E. Minnesregel: Glada Djur Arbetar Enigt. En violin stäms likadant, så fiollåtar ligger naturligt på mandolin.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Low to high: G, D, A, E.
rows.translation: Lågt till högt: G, D, A, E.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Which pair sounds lower?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Now high to low: E, A, D, G.
rows.translation: Nu högt till lågt: E, A, D, G.

rows.source: Tuned pairs, a relaxed pick and four open notes. Play each one cleanly, with both strings of the pair ringing.
rows.translation: Stämda par, avslappnat plektrum och fyra öppna toner. Spela varje ton rent så att båda strängarna i paret klingar.

rows.source: Which pair is the highest in pitch?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Pair 1, E

rows.source: Pairs count from the highest, pair 1, to the lowest, pair 4.
rows.translation: Paren räknas från det högsta, par 1, till det lägsta, par 4.

rows.source: A, G, E, D. Find each pair by its name.
rows.translation: A, G, E, D. Hitta varje par efter namnet.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D pair: open D, E at fret 2 with your first finger, and F sharp at fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb ligger på D-paret: öppet D, E på band 2 med första fingret och Fiss på band 4 med andra.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 2, first finger. That's E.
rows.translation: Par 3, band 2, första fingret. Det är E.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 4, second finger. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Par 3, band 4, andra fingret. Det är Fiss.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: First notes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 “First notes” · title

rows.source: Fret notes cleanly, learn two frets per finger and play the D major scale.
rows.translation: Tryck ned toner rent, lär dig två band per finger och spela D-durskalan.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 “First notes” · unit summary

rows.source: Press both strings of a pair with one fingertip, just behind the metal fret. Mandolin strings are tight, so use the very tip and press only as hard as a clean note needs.
rows.translation: Tryck båda strängarna i ett par med en fingertopp precis bakom metallbandet. Mandolinsträngar är spända, så använd yttersta toppen och tryck bara så hårt som en ren ton kräver.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 2, first finger.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 4, second finger.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does your fingertip go?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Halfway between two frets
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Right behind the fret takes the least pressure and gives the cleanest note.
rows.translation: Precis bakom bandet krävs minst tryck och tonen blir renast.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.translation: Öppen, band 2, band 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: One finger, two frets
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · title

rows.source: Small frets, spread fingers
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Mandolin frets are close together, so each finger covers two. First finger plays frets 1 and 2, second finger 3 and 4, third finger 5 and 6, little finger 7.
rows.translation: Mandolinens band sitter tätt, så varje finger täcker två. Första fingret spelar band 1 och 2, andra 3 och 4, tredje 5 och 6, lillfingret 7.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 5, third finger.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which finger plays fret 4?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fourth finger
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Second finger
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Each finger covers two frets on mandolin, so the second finger handles frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Varje finger täcker två band på mandolin, så andra fingret sköter band 3 och 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Same shape, next pair
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The A pair works the same way: open is A, fret 2 is B, fret 4 is C♯ and fret 5 is D. Your hand stays where it is.
rows.translation: A-paret fungerar likadant: öppet är A, band 2 är B, band 4 är C♯ och band 5 är D. Handen stannar där den är.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open, then first, second and third fingers on pair 2.
rows.translation: Öppen, sedan första, andra och tredje fingret på par 2.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Climb and come back
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Eight notes, two pairs
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Join the two shapes and you have the D major scale: D, E, F♯, G on pair 3, then A, B, C♯, D on pair 2. It is home for a great many fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Sätt ihop greppen så får du D-durskalan: D, E, F♯, G på par 3, sedan A, B, C♯, D på par 2. Den är hemma i väldigt många fiollåtar.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3: open, fret 2, fret 4, fret 5.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Pair 2: open, fret 2, fret 4, fret 5.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What comes after G in the D major scale?
rows.translation: Vad kommer efter G i D-durskalan?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B on fret 2
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A, the open second pair
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G♯ on fret 6
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: After G on pair 3 comes A. Play it on the open A pair rather than reaching for fret 7.
rows.translation: Efter G på par 3 kommer A. Spela det på öppna A-paret i stället för att sträcka dig till band 7.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-3 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A tune from the scale
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Beethoven's melody uses only the first five notes of D major, on pairs 3 and 2. Keep your fingers hovering close to the strings between notes.
rows.translation: Beethovens melodi använder bara D-durskalans fem första toner på par 3 och 2. Håll fingrarna svävande nära strängarna mellan tonerna.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F♯ and G on pair 3, then the open A pair.
rows.translation: F♯ och G på par 3, sedan öppna A-paret.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the second phrase land?

rows.source: On E

rows.source: On A
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On D, the home note
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The first phrase stops on E and sounds unfinished. The second lands on D and sounds like home.
rows.translation: Första frasen stannar på E och låter oavslutad. Den andra landar på D och låter som hemma.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pair 1, same fingers
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the E pair, fret 2 is F♯, fret 3 is G and fret 5 is A. First, second and third fingers, just as before.
rows.translation: På E-paret är band 2 F♯, band 3 G och band 5 A. Första, andra och tredje fingret, precis som förut.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 1: open, fret 2, fret 3, fret 5.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fret 3 sits in the second finger's zone, frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Band 3 ligger i andra fingrets område, band 3 och 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A to A over two pairs
rows.translation: A till A över två par
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-5 “Up to the E pair” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: First-notes challenge
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · title

rows.source: Fingers one, two and three on frets 2, 4 and 5, with open pairs in between. Play smoothly and let each note ring until the next.
rows.translation: Finger ett, två och tre på band 2, 4 och 5, med öppna par emellan. Spela mjukt och låt varje ton klinga tills nästa.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Every other note of the scale: D, F♯, A, D.
rows.translation: Varannan ton i skalan: D, F♯, A, D.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: You need C♯ on pair 2. Which fret?
rows.translation: Du behöver C♯ på par 2. Vilket band?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On pair 2, fret 2 is B, fret 3 is C and fret 4 is C♯.
rows.translation: På par 2 är band 2 B, band 3 C och band 4 C♯.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Does the tune go up or down?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: D all the way up to A
rows.translation: D hela vägen upp till A
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Ode to Joy, up to speed
rows.translation: Ode till glädjen i rätt tempo
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · challenge man-2-6 “First-notes challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Down, up and tremolo
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 “Down, up and tremolo” · title

rows.source: Alternate your pick in eighth notes and make long notes sing with tremolo.
rows.translation: Växla plektrumet i åttondelar och låt långa toner sjunga med tremolo.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 “Down, up and tremolo” · unit summary

rows.source: Down on the beat, up between
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick down on each beat and up on the and in between. Your hand swings like a pendulum, down, up, down, up, even when a note waits.
rows.translation: Slå ned på varje slag och upp på och emellan. Handen svänger som en pendel, ned, upp, ned, upp, även när en ton väntar.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which stroke lands on the beat?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Down on the beat and up in between keeps your hand in time, like a drummer's sticks.
rows.translation: Ned på slaget och upp emellan håller handen i takt som en trummis trumpinnar.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Eighths on open pairs
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Down-up, up the scale
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-1 “Down and up” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Crossing pairs
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · title

rows.source: Keep the pendulum going
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When you move to another pair, your hand keeps its down-up swing. The forearm carries you across; the wrist keeps the beat.
rows.translation: När du flyttar till ett annat par fortsätter handen ned-upp-rörelsen. Underarmen för dig över; handleden håller pulsen.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Rocking between pairs
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: You cross to a new pair on an and. Which stroke?
rows.translation: Du byter till ett nytt par på ett och. Vilket anslag?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Whichever is closer
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke. Let the pendulum decide, not the string.
rows.translation: Varje och får ett uppslag. Låt pendeln avgöra, inte strängen.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D major in eighths
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-2 “Crossing pairs” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Make a note last
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A mandolin note fades quickly. Tremolo keeps it singing: pick down and up fast and evenly on one pair, so the note sounds unbroken.
rows.translation: En mandolinton avtar snabbt. Tremolo håller den sjungande: slå ned och upp snabbt och jämnt på ett par så att tonen låter obruten.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Big, loud strokes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only down strokes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Small, even strokes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Keep the pick close to the strings and the strokes even. Speed comes later, once the motion is relaxed.
rows.translation: Håll plektrumet nära strängarna och anslagen jämna. Farten kommer senare när rörelsen är avslappnad.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Count it, then let go
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start by counting four strokes to each beat. As it gets easier, stop counting and keep the motion quick and steady. The beat lives in your foot, not in your pick.
rows.translation: Börja med att räkna fyra anslag per slag. När det blir lättare slutar du räkna och håller rörelsen snabb och jämn. Pulsen finns i foten, inte i plektrumet.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tremolo through long notes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Tremolo on a slow tune
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Amazing Grace moves in three beats to the bar. Tremolo through each long note and change notes right on the beat. Two notes are new: A and B on the G pair.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace går i tre slag per takt. Spela tremolo genom varje lång ton och byt precis på slaget. Två toner är nya: A och B på G-paret.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, fret 2 with your first finger, then fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Par 4, band 2 med första fingret, sedan band 4 med andra.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How do you hold the long A at the end?
rows.translation: Hur håller du det långa A på slutet?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Pick once and wait
rows.translation: Slår an en gång och väntar
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tremolo until the next beat
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Mute it right away
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A single pick fades long before three beats are up. Tremolo keeps it ringing to the end of the bar.
rows.translation: Ett enda anslag avtar långt innan tre slag gått. Tremolo håller tonen klingande till taktens slut.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Picking challenge
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · title

rows.source: Steady hand, singing notes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Down on the beat, up in between, and tremolo whenever a note needs to last. Keep every stroke small.
rows.translation: Ned på slaget, upp emellan och tremolo när en ton behöver vara länge. Håll varje anslag litet.
