rows.source: Which stroke plays the and of beat 2?
rows.translation: Vilket anslag spelar och efter slag 2?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke, wherever the note is.
rows.translation: Varje och får ett uppslag, var tonen än finns.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sixteenths, two notes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Chords and the chop
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 “Chords and the chop” · title

rows.source: G, D, C, E minor and A, then the short, choked chord that drives bluegrass.
rows.translation: G, D, C, E-moll och A, sedan det korta, strypta ackord som driver bluegrass.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 “Chords and the chop” · unit summary

rows.source: G and D
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · title

rows.source: Your first chord: G
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 2, second finger on fret 3 of pair 1. Pairs 4 and 3 ring open.
rows.translation: Första fingret på band 2 på par 2, andra fingret på band 3 på par 1. Par 4 och 3 klingar öppna.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Brush the pick down across all four pairs in one smooth motion, low to high. Small and light is enough; mandolin chords are bright.
rows.translation: Svep plektrumet ned över alla fyra par i en mjuk rörelse, lågt till högt. Litet och lätt räcker; mandolinackord är ljusa.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D: two fingers on fret 2
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 4, second finger on fret 2 of pair 1. Pairs 3 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Första fingret på band 2 på par 4, andra fingret på band 2 på par 1. Par 3 och 2 klingar öppna.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C and E minor
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · title

rows.source: C: a small step
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 3, second finger on fret 3 of pair 2. Pairs 4 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Första fingret på band 2 på par 3, andra fingret på band 3 på par 2. Par 4 och 1 klingar öppna.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E minor: one fret back
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: From C, slide your second finger back to fret 2. The chord turns darker, though only one finger moved.
rows.translation: Från C glider du andra fingret tillbaka till band 2. Ackordet blir mörkare fast bara ett finger flyttades.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Minor, darker
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: A: four fingers
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · title

rows.source: A with every finger
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fret 2 on pairs 4 and 3, fret 4 on pair 2, fret 5 on pair 1: fingers one, two, three and four. No pair rings open.
rows.translation: Band 2 på par 4 och 3, band 4 på par 2, band 5 på par 1: finger ett, två, tre och fyra. Inget par klingar öppet.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Why does it matter that no pair rings open?
rows.translation: Varför spelar det roll att inget par klingar öppet?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It makes the chord louder
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: You can silence it by easing off
rows.translation: Du kan tysta det genom att lätta
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It keeps the chord in tune
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: With every pair held down, relaxing your fingers stops the sound at once. That is the secret of the chop.
rows.translation: När alla par är nedtryckta stoppar avslappnade fingrar ljudet direkt. Det är hemligheten bakom hugget.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The chop
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · title

rows.source: Strike, then choke
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The chop is a short chord on beats 2 and 4. Strum down, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings without lifting them, so the sound stops right away.
rows.translation: Hugget är ett kort ackord på slag 2 och 4. Slå ned och lätta sedan greppfingrarnas tryck utan att lyfta dem så att ljudet slutar direkt.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which beats get the chop?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: 2 and 4
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bass and guitar take beats 1 and 3. The mandolin answers on 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Bas och gitarr tar slag 1 och 3. Mandolinen svarar på 2 och 4, som en virveltrumma.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Short is the sound
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let the chord sound for only a moment. If it hangs on, relax your fingers sooner. Your fingertips stay touching the strings the whole time.
rows.translation: Låt ackordet låta bara ett ögonblick. Om det hänger kvar, slappna av tidigare i fingrarna. Fingertopparna rör strängarna hela tiden.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Chops in G, C and D
rows.translation: Hugg i G, C och D
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · title

rows.source: Move the A shape
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your A shape works anywhere on the neck. Slide it up three frets for C and five frets for D. Keep all four fingers in place as you move.
rows.translation: Ditt A-grepp fungerar överallt på halsen. Flytta tre band upp för C och fem band för D. Håll alla fyra fingrar på plats när du flyttar.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A chop for G
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: G needs a new stretch: first finger fret 2 on pair 2, second finger fret 3 on pair 1, third finger fret 5 on pair 3, little finger fret 7 on pair 4.
rows.translation: G behöver en ny sträckning: första fingret band 2 på par 2, andra band 3 på par 1, tredje band 5 på par 3, lillfingret band 7 på par 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bluegrass backup
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · title

rows.source: Rhythm for the band
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum open chords to learn the sound, then chop on 2 and 4 to drive the band. Keep the beat steady through every change.
rows.translation: Spela öppna ackord för att lära känna ljudet, hugg sedan på 2 och 4 för att driva bandet. Håll pulsen jämn genom varje byte.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your chop keeps ringing. What fixes it?
rows.translation: Ditt hugg fortsätter klinga. Vad hjälper?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strum harder
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lift your fingers off the neck
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ease off with your fretting fingers sooner
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The chop is choked by the fretting hand. Relax the pressure but keep your fingertips on the strings.
rows.translation: Hugget stryps av grepphanden. Släpp trycket men håll fingertopparna på strängarna.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Fiddle tunes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 “Fiddle tunes” · title

rows.source: Five traditional jam tunes, simplified, from Boil Them Cabbage Down to Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Fem traditionella jamlåtar i förenklad form, från Boil Them Cabbage Down till Old Joe Clark.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 “Fiddle tunes” · unit summary

rows.source: A first jam tune
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This one lives on the E and A pairs and keeps coming back to F♯. Pick down on the beat and up in between, just like your eighth-note drills.
rows.translation: Den här ligger på E- och A-paren och återkommer till F♯. Slå ned på slaget och upp emellan, precis som i åttondelsövningarna.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F♯, G and A on pair 1 at frets 2, 3 and 5, then D on pair 2, fret 5.
rows.translation: F♯, G och A på par 1 på band 2, 3 och 5, sedan D på par 2, band 5.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the tune come to rest?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On F♯
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Like most tunes in D, it ends on D, the home note.
rows.translation: Som de flesta melodier i D slutar den på D, hemmatonen.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Five notes, one sweet tune
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The low part of Angeline the Baker uses only D, E, F♯, A and B. Both parts end on A instead of D, which sends the tune around again.
rows.translation: Den låga delen av Angeline the Baker använder bara D, E, F♯, A och B. Båda delarna slutar på A i stället för D, vilket skickar melodin ett varv till.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Low part, first half
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Low part, second half
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which note do both parts end on?
rows.translation: Vilken ton slutar båda delarna på?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Ending on A instead of D leaves the tune hanging, so it rolls straight into the next time through.
rows.translation: Slutet på A i stället för D lämnar melodin hängande, så den rullar direkt in i nästa varv.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Low part
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A very old favorite
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was in print in Scotland by 1780 and has filled American jams ever since. Its first part bounces between D, F♯ and A.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy fanns i tryck i Skottland senast 1780 och har fyllt amerikanska jams sedan dess. Första delen studsar mellan D, F♯ och A.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A pair, pair 3 fret 4, open D, then fret 4 again.
rows.translation: Öppet A-par, par 3 band 4, öppet D, sedan band 4 igen.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D, F♯ and A together spell which chord?
rows.translation: Vilket ackord bildar D, F♯ och A tillsammans?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D, F♯ and A are the three notes of D major. Fiddle tunes often trace their chords like this.
rows.translation: D, F♯ och A är D-durs tre toner. Fiollåtar tecknar ofta sina ackord så här.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Soldier's Joy, first part
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Low part, high part
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler starts low, down on the G pair, then jumps up to the E pair for a part that tumbles down the scale. It was in print by the 1840s.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler börjar lågt på G-paret och hoppar sedan upp till E-paret för en del som tumlar nedför skalan. Den fanns i tryck senast på 1840-talet.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, frets 2 and 4, then the open D pair.
rows.translation: Par 4, band 2 och 4, sedan öppna D-paret.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the high part begin?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On the open D pair
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On A, fret 5 of the E pair
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On the open G pair
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It opens on A at fret 5 of pair 1, then walks down through G, F♯ and E.
rows.translation: Den börjar på A på band 5 på par 1 och går sedan ned genom G, F♯ och E.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: High part, first half
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: A new key and a twist
rows.translation: En ny tonart och en vändning
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A, so you use C♯ and G♯. In the second part, G♯ drops to plain G on fret 3 of the E pair. That one note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark går i A, så du använder C♯ och G♯. I andra delen sjunker G♯ till vanligt G på band 3 på E-paret. Den enda tonen ger melodin dess gammaldags ljud.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G♯ on pair 3, fret 6; the open A pair; then G on pair 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: G♯ på par 3, band 6; öppna A-paret; sedan G på par 1, band 3.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time sound?
rows.translation: Vilken ton ger andra delen dess gammaldags ljud?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C instead of C♯
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G instead of G♯
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A, the home note
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A major uses G♯. Lowering it to G gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: A-dur använder G♯. Sänkningen till G ger det mixolydiska ljud som finns i old-time och bluegrass.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Jam-session challenge
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · title

rows.source: Call the tunes
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play each tune through at a steady tempo. If a note slips, keep your picking hand moving and catch the next beat. That is how real jams work.
rows.translation: Spela varje melodi igenom i jämnt tempo. Om en ton missas, håll anslagshanden i rörelse och fånga nästa slag. Så fungerar riktiga jams.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Angeline the Baker, low part
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which tune swaps G♯ for G?
rows.translation: Vilken melodi byter G♯ mot G?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A but uses G in its second part. That lowered note is its signature.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark går i A men använder G i andra delen. Den sänkta tonen är dess kännetecken.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler, high part
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Slides, hammers and crosspicking
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 “Slides, hammers and crosspicking” · title

rows.source: Add the left-hand moves and rolling right hand that make a tune sound like bluegrass.
rows.translation: Lägg till vänsterhandens rörelser och rullande högerhand som får melodin att låta bluegrass.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 “Slides, hammers and crosspicking” · unit summary

rows.source: Pick a note, then keep pressing as you glide the same finger up to a higher fret. The new note sounds without a second pick stroke. Light, steady pressure is the trick.
rows.translation: Slå an en ton och behåll trycket medan samma finger glider upp till ett högre band. Den nya tonen ljuder utan nytt anslag. Lätt, jämnt tryck är knepet.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 2 to 4
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: What sounds the second note in a slide?
rows.translation: Vad får andra tonen att ljuda i en slide?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A second pick stroke
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lifting the finger quickly
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your finger pressing as it moves
rows.translation: Fingrets tryck medan det rör sig
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressure on the string as you slide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Bara första tonen slås an. Behåll trycket på strängen när du glider, annars dör tonen på vägen.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Hammer-ons and pull-offs
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · title

rows.source: Pick an open pair, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick stroke.
rows.translation: Slå an ett öppet par och slå sedan ned en fingertopp precis bakom band 2. Den nya tonen ljuder bara av nedslaget, utan nytt plektrumanslag.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open to fret 2
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: The reverse: with a finger on fret 2, pick, then pull the finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open note below.
rows.translation: Omvänt: med ett finger på band 2 slår du an och drar sedan fingret lite åt sidan när du lyfter. Rörelsen knäpper igång den öppna tonen nedanför.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 2 to open
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Which moves sound a note without the pick?
rows.translation: Vilka rörelser ger en ton utan plektrum?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Only hammer-ons
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs and slides
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only tremolo
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: All three sound a second note with the fretting hand. The pick plays only the first.
rows.translation: Alla tre ger en andra ton med grepphanden. Plektrumet spelar bara den första.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Hammer, pull, repeat
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Dress up a tune
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · title

rows.source: Ornaments in Old Joe Clark
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fiddle tunes come alive with small ornaments. Here the two plain A notes that open Old Joe Clark become A, B, A: a hammer-on and a pull-off.
rows.translation: Fiollåtar får liv av små utsmyckningar. Här blir de två vanliga A-tonerna i början av Old Joe Clark A, B, A: en hammer-on och en pull-off.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In A, B, A, how many times do you pick?
rows.translation: Hur många anslag gör du i A, B, A?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Once
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Twice
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three times
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pick the first A, hammer on to B and pull off back to A. One pick, three notes.
rows.translation: Slå an första A, gör hammer-on till B och pull-off tillbaka till A. Ett anslag, tre toner.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: First part, dressed up
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Old Joe Clark, dressed up
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Rolling across three pairs
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Crosspicking picks single notes across three pairs in a repeating pattern, so a chord sounds like a ripple. Eight notes split three, three and two.
rows.translation: Crosspicking slår an enstaka toner över tre par i ett upprepat mönster, så att ackordet låter som en krusning. Åtta toner delas i tre, tre och två.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Ripple over G
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How are the eight notes of a crosspicking bar grouped?
rows.translation: Hur grupperas de åtta tonerna i en crosspicking-takt?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A three-note pattern repeated across a bar of eight makes the accent shift each time. That is the rolling feel.
rows.translation: Ett tretonsmönster som upprepas över en takt med åtta flyttar betoningen varje gång. Det ger den rullande känslan.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Ripple over C
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Ripple through G, C and D
rows.translation: Krusning genom G, C och D
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Bluegrass mandolin challenge
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · title

rows.source: Everything in one session
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slides, hammer-ons, chops and crosspicking. Take each one at your own pace, and keep the beat steady above all.
rows.translation: Slides, hammer-ons, hugg och crosspicking. Ta var och en i egen takt och håll framför allt pulsen jämn.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which beats does the chop land on?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Five-string, open G: rolls, old-time tunes and clawhammer
rows.translation: Femsträngad, öppet G: rullningar, old-time-låtar och clawhammer
rows.context: Banjo course · course subtitle

rows.source: Hello, banjo
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 “Hello, banjo” · title

rows.source: Meet the five strings, tune to open G, find the drone string and play a song.
rows.translation: Lär känna de fem strängarna, stäm till öppet G, hitta bordunsträngen och spela en låt.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 “Hello, banjo” · unit summary

rows.source: Meet your banjo
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · title

rows.source: Five strings, one short
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A banjo has four full-length strings and a fifth that starts partway up the neck, at its own little tuning peg. That short string is the banjo's signature sound.
rows.translation: En banjo har fyra fullånga strängar och en femte som börjar en bit upp på halsen vid en egen liten stämskruv. Den korta strängen är banjons karakteristiska ljud.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Counting the strings
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: String 1 is the thin one nearest the floor. Strings 2, 3 and 4 follow toward your face. The short one on top is string 5.
rows.translation: Sträng 1 är den tunna närmast golvet. Sträng 2, 3 och 4 följer mot ansiktet. Den korta överst är sträng 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string is the short one?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The fifth string lies next to string 4 but starts at the fifth fret, with its peg on the side of the neck.
rows.translation: Femte strängen ligger intill sträng 4 men börjar vid femte bandet, med stämskruven på halsens sida.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the thin one nearest the floor.
rows.translation: Knäpp sträng 1, den tunna närmast golvet.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the short string, string 5. Pluck it with your thumb.
rows.translation: Nu den korta strängen, sträng 5. Knäpp med tummen.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open G tuning
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · title

rows.source: All five make G
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Standard banjo tuning is open G. From string 4 to string 1 it reads D, G, B, D, and the short fifth string is a high G. Strummed open, they make a G chord.
rows.translation: Standardstämning för banjo är öppet G. Från sträng 4 till sträng 1 är det D, G, B, D, och den korta femte strängen är ett högt G. Öppna bildar de ett G-ackord.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Strings 4, 3, 2 and 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.translation: Sträng 4, 3, 2 och 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 5: high G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What chord do the open strings make?
rows.translation: Vilket ackord bildar de öppna strängarna?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G chord. That is why this tuning is called open G.
rows.translation: G, B och D är tonerna i ett G-ackord. Därför kallas stämningen öppet G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · title

rows.source: Three picks, three fingers
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bluegrass banjo uses a plastic thumb pick and two metal finger picks, on index and middle. The finger picks point down, curving the same way as your fingertips.
rows.translation: Bluegrassbanjo använder ett tumplektrum av plast och två fingerplektrum av metall på pek- och långfingret. Fingerplektrumen pekar nedåt och böjer sig som fingertopparna.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Who plays what
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: For now your thumb plays strings 3, 4 and 5, your index plays string 2 and your middle plays string 1. Rest your ring and little fingers lightly on the head.
rows.translation: Tills vidare spelar tummen sträng 3, 4 och 5, pekfingret sträng 2 och långfingret sträng 1. Vila ring- och lillfingret lätt på skinnet.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger plays string 2?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Thumb
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Index
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Thumb takes strings 3, 4 and 5, index takes string 2 and middle takes string 1.
rows.translation: Tummen tar sträng 3, 4 och 5, pekfingret sträng 2 och långfingret sträng 1.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: All five strings
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: The drone string
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · title

rows.source: A note that never changes
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The fifth string is a drone: you play it open, between melody notes, and it rings over everything. In these lessons you never fret it.
rows.translation: Femte strängen är en bordun: du spelar den öppen mellan meloditonerna och den klingar över allt. I de här lektionerna trycker du aldrig ned den.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First string 5, then string 1. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Först sträng 5, sedan sträng 1. Vilken är högre?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Why does the fifth string sound so high?
rows.translation: Varför låter femte strängen så högt?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It is the thickest string
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It is short and tuned to high G
rows.translation: Den är kort och stämd till högt G
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It is always fretted
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Being short lets it hold a high G. It sits on top of the melody like a bell.
rows.translation: Kortheten låter den hålla ett högt G. Den ligger ovanpå melodin som en klocka.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Drone between notes
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Thumb on the drone
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Open G challenge
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · title

rows.source: Tuned to open G, picks on, thumb ready for the drone. Play each string cleanly and let it ring.
rows.translation: Stämt till öppet G, plektrum på, tummen redo för bordunen. Spela varje sträng rent och låt den klinga.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B, high G, low D, high D, G. Find each string by its note.
rows.translation: B, högt G, lågt D, högt D, G. Hitta varje sträng efter tonen.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which finger plays string 1?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 3, then string 5. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Sträng 3, sedan sträng 5. Vilken är högre?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Open G roll call
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger frets the A; your thumb picks string 3.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb behöver tre toner: öppen sträng 2 är B, band 2 på sträng 3 är A och öppen sträng 3 är G. Andra fingret trycker ned A; tummen knäpper sträng 3.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · song bjo-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Rolls
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 “Rolls” · title

rows.source: The right-hand patterns behind the rolling bluegrass sound: pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll.
rows.translation: Högerhandsmönstren bakom bluegrassens rullande ljud: dubbelknäpp, växlande tumme och framåtrullning.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 “Rolls” · unit summary

rows.source: The pinch
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · title

rows.source: Thumb and middle together
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A pinch is your thumb and middle finger plucking at the same moment, on strings 5 and 1. It sounds like a little two-note chord and often starts or ends a phrase.
rows.translation: Ett dubbelknäpp är när tumme och långfinger knäpper samtidigt på sträng 5 och 1. Det låter som ett litet tvåtonsackord och inleder eller avslutar ofta en fras.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pinch, or one note at a time?
rows.translation: Dubbelknäpp eller en ton i taget?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Together, a pinch
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: One after the other
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which strings does a pinch play?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: 4 and 3
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 5 and 1
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 2 and 1
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Thumb on the short fifth string and middle on string 1, at the same moment.
rows.translation: Tummen på korta femte strängen och långfingret på sträng 1 samtidigt.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Alternating thumb roll
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · title

rows.source: Thumb, index, thumb, middle
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This roll is eight even notes: thumb on 3, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1, then thumb on 4, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1.
rows.translation: Rullningen har åtta jämna toner: tumme på 3, pekfinger på 2, tumme på 5, långfinger på 1, sedan tumme på 4, pekfinger på 2, tumme på 5, långfinger på 1.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Alternating thumb, slowly
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which finger plays every other note?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb, index, thumb, middle: the thumb plays every other note, which gives the roll its name.
rows.translation: Tumme, pekfinger, tumme, långfinger: tummen spelar varannan ton, vilket ger rullningen dess namn.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Forward roll
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · title

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, again
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The forward roll moves one way, thumb then index then middle, over and over. Eight notes make thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index.
rows.translation: Framåtrullningen går åt ett håll, tumme, pekfinger, långfinger, om och om igen. Åtta toner blir tumme, pekfinger, långfinger två gånger, sedan tumme, pekfinger.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Forward roll, slowly
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: How does a forward roll fit into eight notes?
rows.translation: Hur ryms en framåtrullning i åtta toner?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index. The accent shifts as it goes, which makes the rolling sound.
rows.translation: Tumme, pekfinger, långfinger två gånger, sedan tumme, pekfinger. Betoningen flyttas längs vägen och ger det rullande ljudet.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Rolls in time
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · title

rows.source: Even beats, any roll
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A roll is only as good as its timing. Keep all eight notes even, like a ticking clock, and land the first note of each bar right on the beat.
rows.translation: En rullning är bara så bra som dess tajming. Håll alla åtta toner jämna som en tickande klocka och landa första tonen i varje takt precis på slaget.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Alternating thumb at 72
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Forward roll at 72
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: You lose the beat in the middle of a roll. What now?
rows.translation: Du tappar pulsen mitt i en rullning. Vad gör du?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Stop and start the bar over
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slow down until it feels right
rows.translation: Saktar ned tills det känns rätt
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Keep the right hand moving and rejoin
rows.translation: Håller högerhanden i rörelse och hittar in
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In a band the beat never waits. Keep the pattern going and catch the next bar.
rows.translation: I ett band väntar pulsen aldrig. Håll mönstret igång och fånga nästa takt.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Switching rolls
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Rolls, start to finish
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll, all on open strings. Keep the eighths even and let every string ring.
rows.translation: Dubbelknäpp, växlande tumme och framåtrullning, allt på öppna strängar. Håll åttondelarna jämna och låt varje sträng klinga.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which roll goes thumb, index, middle, over and over?
rows.translation: Vilken rullning går tumme, pekfinger, långfinger om och om igen?

rows.source: Chords with rolls
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 “Chords with rolls” · title

rows.source: Fret G, C, D7 and E minor and keep the roll going through the changes.
rows.translation: Ta G, C, D7 och E-moll och håll rullningen igång genom bytena.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 “Chords with rolls” · unit summary

rows.source: The C chord
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · title

rows.source: C: three fingers
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third finger on fret 2 of string 1. Strings 3 and 5 ring open.
rows.translation: Första fingret på band 1 på sträng 2, andra på band 2 på sträng 4, tredje på band 2 på sträng 1. Sträng 3 och 5 klingar öppna.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do you fret the fifth string for C?
rows.translation: Trycker du ned femte strängen i C?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Yes, at fret 2
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: No, it rings open
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Yes, at fret 5
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The open high G belongs to the C chord, so it rings as it is. You never fret it in these lessons.
rows.translation: Det öppna höga G hör till C-ackordet, så det klingar som det är. Du trycker aldrig ned det i de här lektionerna.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D7: two fingers
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 3. Strings 4 and 1 ring open. Leave the fifth string out; its G clashes with D7.
rows.translation: Första fingret på band 1 på sträng 2, andra på band 2 på sträng 3. Sträng 4 och 1 klingar öppna. Utelämna femte strängen; dess G skär sig mot D7.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The full D7, if you like
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The two-finger D7 has no F sharp. Add your little finger at fret 4 of string 1 and all four notes of D7 ring. Either shape works in the songs; the full one sounds richer.
rows.translation: D7 med två fingrar saknar Fiss. Lägg lillfingret på band 4 på sträng 1 så klingar alla fyra D7-toner. Båda greppen fungerar i låtarna; det fullständiga låter rikare.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord wants to move on?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: What does your thumb do on D7?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Plays string 5 as usual
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Frets string 5
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stays on strings 3 and 4
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The open G of string 5 isn't part of D7. For now your thumb keeps to strings 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Det öppna G på sträng 5 hör inte till D7. Tills vidare håller sig tummen på sträng 3 och 4.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Alternating thumb on D7
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: G, C and D7
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · title

rows.source: Three chords, many songs
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: G is home, C steps away and D7 pulls you back. Change on the first beat of each bar and keep your right hand moving.
rows.translation: G är hemma, C går bort och D7 drar tillbaka. Byt på första slaget i varje takt och håll högerhanden i rörelse.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord pulls you back to G?
rows.translation: Vilket ackord drar tillbaka till G?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 contains C, which leans down to B in the G chord. That pull is why so many songs end D7 to G.
rows.translation: D7 innehåller C, som lutar ned mot B i G-ackordet. Därför slutar så många låtar med D7 till G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: E minor: lift one finger
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-4 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Make C, then lift your first finger off string 2. Two fingers stay on fret 2, strings 4 and 1, and the chord turns darker: E minor.
rows.translation: Ta C och lyft sedan första fingret från sträng 2. Två fingrar stannar på band 2, sträng 4 och 1, och ackordet blir mörkare: E-moll.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-4 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-4 “E minor” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · title

rows.source: Fret, roll, change
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four chords and two rolls. Keep the right hand steady even while the left hand is busy changing.
rows.translation: Fyra ackord och två rullningar. Håll högerhanden jämn även när vänsterhanden är upptagen med byten.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string sits out on D7?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Alternating thumb: G, C, D7, G
rows.translation: Växlande tumme: G, C, D7, G

rows.source: Forward roll: G, E minor, C, D7, G

rows.source: Four traditional tunes, with the drone string ringing in among the melody.
rows.translation: Fyra traditionella melodier med bordunsträngen klingande bland meloditonerna.

rows.source: Melody on top
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Here the melody is the main event: pick each note with the finger that owns its string. Strings 3, 2 and 1 carry this whole tune.
rows.translation: Här står melodin i centrum: knäpp varje ton med fingret som sköter strängen. Sträng 3, 2 och 1 bär hela melodin.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 2 open, string 3 fret 2, string 3 open, string 2 fret 1, string 1 open.
rows.translation: Sträng 2 öppen, sträng 3 band 2, sträng 3 öppen, sträng 2 band 1, sträng 1 öppen.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note does the tune end on?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Tunes in G come home to G, here the open third string.
rows.translation: Melodier i G kommer hem till G, här den öppna tredje strängen.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: High part, low part
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cripple Creek has a high part that uses the fifth string as a melody note, and a low part down on strings 3 and 4. Take each part slowly first.
rows.translation: Cripple Creek har en hög del som använder femte strängen som meloditon och en låg del nere på sträng 3 och 4. Ta först varje del långsamt.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 5 open, then string 1 at fret 4 and fret 2.
rows.translation: Sträng 5 öppen, sedan sträng 1 på band 4 och band 2.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the high G in the first bar come from?
rows.translation: Varifrån kommer det höga G i första takten?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The open fifth string
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 3, open
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The drone doubles as a melody note here. Your thumb plays it, right on the beat.
rows.translation: Bordunen är även meloditon här. Tummen spelar den precis på slaget.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A tune named for a mountain pass
rows.translation: En melodi uppkallad efter ett bergspass
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cumberland Gap is the pass early settlers took into Kentucky. The tune climbs to E and F♯ on string 1, so your second and fourth fingers get busy.
rows.translation: Cumberland Gap är passet som tidiga nybyggare tog in i Kentucky. Melodin klättrar till E och F♯ på sträng 1, så andra och fjärde fingret får jobba.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 4, fret 2, then open.
rows.translation: Sträng 1: band 2, band 4, band 2, sedan öppen.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where do you play F♯ in this tune?
rows.translation: Var spelar du F♯ i den här melodin?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 2, fret 4
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 1, fret 4
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 5, fret 1
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: F♯ is four frets above the open D of string 1. The fifth string is never fretted here.
rows.translation: F♯ ligger fyra band över öppet D på sträng 1. Femte strängen trycks aldrig ned här.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Shady Grove has the dark, old sound players call mountain minor. It comes to rest on A instead of G, and the high G of the fifth string sings against it.
rows.translation: Shady Grove har det mörka, gamla ljud som kallas mountain minor. Den kommer till ro på A i stället för G och femte strängens höga G sjunger mot det.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3 fret 2, string 2 open, string 1 open, string 1 fret 2.
rows.translation: Sträng 3 band 2, sträng 2 öppen, sträng 1 öppen, sträng 1 band 2.

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · title

rows.source: Four tunes, steady time
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Which tune comes to rest on A instead of G?
rows.translation: Vilken melodi kommer till ro på A i stället för G?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Shady Grove is in mountain minor, centered on A. The others come home to G.
rows.translation: Shady Grove går i mountain minor med A som centrum. De andra kommer hem till G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · challenge bjo-4-5 “Tune challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sound notes with the fretting hand, then use them in Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Låt grepphanden skapa toner och använd dem sedan i Old Joe Clark.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 “Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides” · unit summary

rows.source: Pick an open string, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick.
rows.translation: Slå an en öppen sträng och slå sedan ned en fingertopp precis bakom band 2. Den nya tonen ljuder bara av nedslaget, utan nytt anslag.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pick string 3 open, then hammer fret 2 with your second finger.
rows.translation: Slå an sträng 3 öppen och gör hammer-on på band 2 med andra fingret.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How many times do you pick for a hammer-on?
rows.translation: Hur många anslag gör du för en hammer-on?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Twice, once per note
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Once, for the first note
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Not at all
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The pick sounds the first note. The second comes from your finger striking the string.
rows.translation: Plektrumet ger första tonen. Den andra kommer av att fingret slår ned på strängen.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Hammer and roll
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Fret a note, pick it, then pull your finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open string, so a second note sounds without the pick.
rows.translation: Tryck ned en ton, slå an och dra fingret lite åt sidan när du lyfter. Rörelsen knäpper den öppna strängen, så en andra ton ljuder utan plektrum.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pick string 1 at fret 2, then pull off to open.
rows.translation: Slå an sträng 1 på band 2 och gör sedan pull-off till öppen.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which way does your finger move in a pull-off?
rows.translation: Åt vilket håll rör sig fingret i en pull-off?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Straight up, off the string
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Along the string to the next fret
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slightly sideways, plucking the string
rows.translation: Lite åt sidan så att strängen knäpps
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lifting straight up only stops the note. A small sideways flick plucks the open string.
rows.translation: Att lyfta rakt upp stoppar bara tonen. En liten sidorörelse knäpper den öppna strängen.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The bluegrass slide
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fret string 3 at fret 2, pick it, and slide the same finger up to fret 4 while pressing. A to B in one smooth glide is a classic banjo sound.
rows.translation: Tryck ned sträng 3 på band 2, slå an och glid samma finger upp till band 4 med bibehållet tryck. A till B i ett mjukt glid är ett klassiskt banjoljud.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 2 to 4
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: What keeps a slide sounding?
rows.translation: Vad håller ljudet igång i en slide?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Steady pressure while you move
rows.translation: Jämnt tryck medan du rör dig
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lifting at the end
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressing as you glide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Bara första tonen slås an. Fortsätt trycka när du glider, annars dör tonen på vägen.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: The old-time F
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in G, but its second part uses F instead of F♯, on string 1 at fret 3. That lowered note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark går i G men använder F i stället för F♯ i andra delen, på sträng 1 på band 3. Den sänkta tonen ger melodin dess gammaldags ljud.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 3, fret 2, open. Try hammering from 2 to 3.
rows.translation: Sträng 1: band 2, band 3, band 2, öppen. Prova hammer-on från 2 till 3.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time color?
rows.translation: Vilken ton ger andra delen dess gammaldags färg?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F instead of F♯
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G, the home note
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G major uses F♯. Lowering it to F gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: G-dur använder F♯. Sänkningen till F ger det mixolydiska ljud som finns i old-time och bluegrass.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · title

rows.source: Left hand, meet right hand
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs and slides, then Old Joe Clark. Pick only where you need to and let your fretting hand do the rest.
rows.translation: Hammer-ons, pull-offs och slides, sedan Old Joe Clark. Slå bara an där det behövs och låt grepphanden göra resten.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which move glides a fretted note up to a higher fret?
rows.translation: Vilken rörelse glider en nedtryckt ton upp till ett högre band?

rows.source: A different right hand: strike down with a fingernail and catch the drone with your thumb.
rows.translation: En annan högerhand: slå ned med nageln och fånga bordunen med tummen.

rows.source: A new right hand
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · title

rows.source: Claw shape
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Clawhammer uses no picks. Curl your hand into a loose claw and strike down on a string with the back of your index or middle fingernail, moving from the wrist and forearm.
rows.translation: Clawhammer använder inga plektrum. Forma handen till en lös klo och slå ned på strängen med baksidan av pek- eller långfingernageln, med rörelse från handled och underarm.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The thumb catches string 5
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: As your hand strikes, the thumb comes to rest on the fifth string. On the next beat it pushes through that string as your hand lifts.
rows.translation: När handen slår landar tummen på femte strängen. På nästa slag trycker den genom strängen medan handen lyfts.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which way does your fingernail move in clawhammer?
rows.translation: Åt vilket håll rör sig nageln i clawhammer?

rows.source: Up, like a finger pick
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Down, toward the floor

rows.source: Side to side
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Clawhammer strikes down with the nail. The fingers never pluck upward.
rows.translation: Clawhammer slår ned med nageln. Fingrarna knäpper aldrig uppåt.

rows.source: Down the strings
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: The basic clawhammer rhythm sounds like its name. Bum: strike one note on the beat. Dit: brush down across the strings. Ty: your thumb plays string 5.
rows.translation: Clawhammers grundrytm låter som sitt namn. Bum: slå en ton på slaget. Dit: svep ned över strängarna. Ty: tummen spelar sträng 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which part of bum-ditty does the thumb play?
rows.translation: Vilken del av bum-ditty spelar tummen?

rows.source: Bum, the first
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bum is a single note, dit is a brush and ty is the thumb on the fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum är en ton, dit ett svep och ty tummen på femte strängen.

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · title

rows.source: The melody rides on bum
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In clawhammer the melody notes fall on the bum strikes. The brush and thumb fill in around them, so tune and rhythm come out together.
rows.translation: I clawhammer ligger meloditonerna på bum-slagen. Svepet och tummen fyller ut runt dem, så melodi och rytm kommer tillsammans.

rows.source: Bum-ditty on C

rows.source: Where do the melody notes go in bum-ditty?

rows.translation: Skip to My Lou var en sällskapslek på 1840-talet. I clawhammer är varje meloditon ett bum, följt av ett svep och tummen på sträng 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The melody alone

rows.translation: Vad spelar tummen efter varje svep?

rows.source: Higher or lower

rows.source: Tell which of two notes is higher, from wide leaps down to the smallest step.
rows.translation: Hör vilken av två toner som är högre, från stora språng till minsta steg.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · unit summary

rows.source: High and low
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · title

rows.source: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. On a keyboard, low notes sit on the left and high notes on the right. Your ear already knows the difference; here you sharpen it.
rows.translation: Tonhöjd är hur hög eller låg en ton låter. På ett klaviatur ligger låga toner till vänster och höga till höger. Örat kan redan skilja dem åt; här vässar du det.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up or down
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the second note is higher, the melody moves up. When it's lower, it moves down. Trace the direction in the air with your hand as you listen.
rows.translation: När den andra tonen är högre går melodin upp. När den är lägre går melodin ned. Rita riktningen i luften med handen medan du lyssnar.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does the second note go up or down?
rows.translation: Går den andra tonen upp eller ned?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Smaller leaps
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · title

rows.source: Closer together
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The closer two notes are, the harder they are to tell apart. Let each note finish before you answer. Every answer, right or wrong, trains your ear.
rows.translation: Ju närmare två toner ligger, desto svårare är de att skilja åt. Låt varje ton klinga klart innan du svarar. Alla svar, rätt eller fel, tränar örat.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hum the gap
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Not sure? Hum the first note, then slide your voice to the second. Feel whether your voice climbs or sinks. Your body knows the direction.
rows.translation: Osäker? Nynna första tonen och glid sedan med rösten till den andra. Känn om rösten stiger eller sjunker. Kroppen vet riktningen.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Next-door notes
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · title

rows.source: Many melodies move to the very next note of the scale: a small step. Steps sound smooth and close. Listen for a gentle lift or dip instead of a jump.
rows.translation: Många melodier går till skalans nästa ton: ett litet steg. Steg låter mjuka och täta. Lyssna efter en lätt höjning eller sänkning i stället för ett språng.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Keep the first note
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold the first note in your head while the second one plays. Then compare them, like checking two heights side by side.
rows.translation: Håll första tonen i huvudet medan den andra spelas. Jämför dem sedan som två höjder bredvid varandra.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The smallest step
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · title

rows.source: The half step
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The smallest step in most music is the half step, also called a semitone: from one key on a keyboard to the very next. It's a tiny move, and you can learn to hear it.
rows.translation: Det minsta steget i de flesta sorters musik är halvtonssteg, även kallat halvton: från en tangent till nästa. Det är en liten rörelse som du kan lära dig höra.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Trust your first impression
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: With tiny steps, your first impression is usually right. Answer, and don't talk yourself out of it.
rows.translation: Vid små steg är första intrycket oftast rätt. Svara och prata inte bort din känsla.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Higher or lower challenge
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · title

rows.source: All sizes, all registers
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Wide leaps, small steps and half steps, high and low, all mixed together. Take a breath before each one.
rows.translation: Stora språng, små steg och halvtonssteg, högt och lågt, allt blandat. Ta ett andetag före varje.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Same or different
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · title

rows.source: Hear when two notes match, then match a note with your voice or instrument.
rows.translation: Hör när två toner matchar och matcha sedan en ton med röst eller instrument.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · unit summary

rows.source: Same or different?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · title

rows.source: Two notes match when they have exactly the same pitch. Listen for whether the second note lands right on the first or slips away from it.
rows.translation: Två toner matchar när de har exakt samma tonhöjd. Lyssna efter om den andra landar precis på den första eller glider ifrån.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Two voices sing exactly the same pitch. What's that called?
rows.translation: Två röster sjunger exakt samma tonhöjd. Vad kallas det?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A chord
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: An octave
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Singing in unison means singing the very same note.
rows.translation: Att sjunga unisont betyder att sjunga precis samma ton.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Match a note
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · title

rows.source: Sing it back
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To match a pitch, listen, hear the note again in your head, then sing or play it. Timbre shows whether you're high or low. Slide until you land on it.
rows.translation: För att matcha en tonhöjd lyssnar du, hör tonen igen i huvudet och sjunger eller spelar den. Timbre visar om du är för hög eller låg. Glid tills du landar rätt.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the note you just heard.
rows.translation: Sjung eller spela tillbaka tonen du nyss hörde.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sing or play back the second note you heard.
rows.translation: Sjung eller spela tillbaka den andra tonen du hörde.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Slide into tune
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If you're off, don't stop. Slide slowly up or down until the note locks in. That slide is how your ear and voice learn to agree.
rows.translation: Stanna inte om du hamnar fel. Glid långsamt upp eller ned tills tonen sitter. Så lär sig örat och rösten att komma överens.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold it in your head
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · title

rows.source: Inner hearing
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you sing, replay the note silently in your head. Musicians call this audiation: hearing music that isn't sounding. It's the heart of a good ear.
rows.translation: Spela upp tonen tyst i huvudet innan du sjunger. Musiker kallar det audiation: att höra musik som inte ljuder. Det är kärnan i ett bra gehör.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the higher note.
rows.translation: Sjung eller spela tillbaka den högre tonen.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sing or play back the lower note.
