rows.source: The fourth line up is D, the Does of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Fjärde linjen upp är D, som Dansar i En Glad Björn Dansar Fint.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the bottom three lines: E, G, B.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung de tre nedersta linjerna: E, G, B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Treble clef spaces
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · title

rows.source: FACE in the spaces
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The four spaces of the treble staff spell a word from bottom to top: F, A, C, E. The spaces spell FACE.
rows.translation: G-klavens fyra mellanrum bildar ett engelskt ord nedifrån och upp: F, A, C, E. Mellanrummen stavar FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The bottom space is F, the first letter of FACE.
rows.translation: Nedersta mellanrummet är F, första bokstaven i FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The third space up is C: F, A, C.
rows.translation: Tredje mellanrummet upp är C: F, A, C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The second space up is A: F, A.
rows.translation: Andra mellanrummet upp är A: F, A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Lines and spaces together
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put them together and the staff climbs E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: line, space, line, space, all the way up.
rows.translation: Sätt ihop dem så stiger notsystemet E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: linje, mellanrum, linje, mellanrum hela vägen upp.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The top space is E, the last letter of FACE.
rows.translation: Översta mellanrummet är E, sista bokstaven i FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The second line up is G, where the treble clef curls.
rows.translation: Andra linjen upp är G, där G-klaven slingrar sig.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the spaces from bottom to top: F, A, C, E.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung mellanrummen nedifrån och upp: F, A, C, E.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Ledger lines and middle C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · title

rows.source: Ledger lines
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When a note goes above or below the staff, short extra lines called ledger lines extend it. Middle C sits on one ledger line just below the treble staff.
rows.translation: När en ton går över eller under systemet förlängs det med korta hjälplinjer. Ettstrukna C ligger på en hjälplinje precis under G-klavens system.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: One ledger line below the treble staff is middle C.
rows.translation: En hjälplinje under G-klavens system är ettstrukna C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D hangs in the space just below the bottom line.
rows.translation: D hänger i mellanrummet precis under nedersta linjen.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Above the staff
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Above the top line, the pattern keeps going. G sits just above the top line, and A sits on the first ledger line above.
rows.translation: Ovanför översta linjen fortsätter mönstret. G ligger precis över översta linjen och A på första hjälplinjen ovanför.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: One ledger line above the treble staff is A.
rows.translation: En hjälplinje över G-klavens system är A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Count down: middle C on the first ledger line, B below it, A on the second ledger line.
rows.translation: Räkna ned: ettstrukna C på första hjälplinjen, B under, A på andra hjälplinjen.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then D and E, climbing from the ledger line onto the staff.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung ettstrukna C, sedan D och E, från hjälplinjen upp på notsystemet.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Bass clef basics
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · title

rows.source: The bass clef
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Low instruments and voices read the bass clef, or F clef. Its two dots surround the fourth line up, marking the F below middle C.
rows.translation: Låga instrument och röster läser F-klav, även kallad basklav. Dess två punkter omger fjärde linjen nedifrån och markerar F under ettstrukna C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note do the bass clef's dots mark?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The bass clef is the F clef: its dots frame the F line.
rows.translation: Basklaven är F-klaven: punkterna ramar in F-linjen.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Good Boys Do Fine Always
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The bass staff's lines, bottom to top, are G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always. The spaces are A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass.
rows.translation: F-klavens linjer nedifrån är G, B, D, F, A: Glada Björnar Dansar Framför Alla. Mellanrummen är A, C, E, G: Alla Clowner Efterliknar Grisar.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The bottom line of the bass staff is G, the Good of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: F-klavens nedersta linje är G, som Glada i Glada Björnar Dansar Framför Alla.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The second space up is C: All Cows.
rows.translation: Andra mellanrummet upp är C: Alla Clowner.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The top line of the bass staff is A, the Always of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: F-klavens översta linje är A, som Alla i Glada Björnar Dansar Framför Alla.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Where is middle C in bass clef?
rows.translation: Var ligger ettstrukna C i F-klav?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On a ledger line above the staff
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On the middle line
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In the bottom space
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Middle C sits one ledger line above the bass staff, and one below the treble staff.
rows.translation: Ettstrukna C ligger en hjälplinje över F-klavens system och en under G-klavens.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the bass clef spaces: A, C, E, G.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung F-klavens mellanrum: A, C, E, G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Staff reading challenge
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · title

rows.source: Read it at a glance
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lines, spaces, ledger lines and both clefs. Use your memory sentences, then try to recognize each note at a glance.
rows.translation: Linjer, mellanrum, hjälplinjer och båda klaverna. Använd minnesmeningarna och försök sedan känna igen varje ton med en blick.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The third space up in bass clef is E: All Cows Eat.
rows.translation: Tredje mellanrummet upp i F-klav är E: Alla Clowner Efterliknar.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then E, G, and the C in the third space.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung ettstrukna C, sedan E, G och C i tredje mellanrummet.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Rhythm and time
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 “Rhythm and time” · title

rows.source: Note values from whole to sixteenth, dots and rests, and the meters 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8.
rows.translation: Notvärden från helnot till sextondel, punkter och pauser samt taktarterna 4/4, 3/4 och 6/8.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 “Rhythm and time” · unit summary

rows.source: Beats and bars
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · title

rows.source: The beat
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. Beats are grouped into bars, also called measures. In most music, each bar holds four beats.
rows.translation: Slaget är den jämna puls du stampar foten till. Slag grupperas i takter, på engelska bar eller measure. I de flesta sorters musik har varje takt fyra slag.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count every bar
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count each bar out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4. Beat 1, the downbeat, usually feels strongest. Lean into it a little.
rows.translation: Räkna varje takt högt: 1, 2, 3, 4. Slag 1, taktens första slag, känns oftast starkast. Betona det lite.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What's another word for a bar?
rows.translation: Vilket ord betyder samma sak som engelskans bar?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Beat
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Rest

rows.source: Measure
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bar and measure mean the same thing.
rows.translation: Engelskans bar och measure betyder båda takt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which beat usually feels strongest?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Beat 4
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 3
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1, the downbeat, starts each bar.
rows.translation: Slag 1, det första slaget, börjar varje takt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, half and quarter notes
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · title

rows.source: Note values
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A note's shape tells you how long it lasts. In a four-beat bar, a whole note lasts all four beats, a half note two, and a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Notens form visar hur länge den varar. I en fyrslagstakt varar en helnot alla fyra slag, en halvnot två och en fjärdedelsnot ett.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats does a half note last?
rows.translation: Hur många slag varar en halvnot?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two half notes fill a four-beat bar.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many quarter notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Hur många fjärdedelsnoter fyller en takt med fyra slag?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, so four fill the bar.
rows.translation: En fjärdedelsnot varar ett slag, så fyra fyller takten.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which lasts longest?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A whole note
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, a half note two, a quarter note one.
rows.translation: En helnot varar fyra slag, en halvnot två, en fjärdedelsnot ett.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Mix them
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.translation: En takt kan blanda notvärden om summan stämmer. En halvnot plus två fjärdedelsnoter fyller fyra slag: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Eighth and sixteenth notes
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
rows.translation: En åttondel varar ett halvt slag, så två ryms per slag. Räkna 1 och 2 och 3 och 4 och, med och mellan slagen.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
rows.translation: En åttondelsnot varar ett halvt slag.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
rows.translation: En sextondel varar en fjärdedels slag, så fyra ryms per slag. Räkna 1 e och a, 2 e och a.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
rows.translation: Hur många sextondelar motsvarar en fjärdedelsnot?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
rows.translation: En fjärdedelsnot är ett slag och fyra sextondelar ryms på ett slag.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Hur många åttondelar fyller en takt med fyra slag?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
rows.translation: Två per slag, fyra slag: åtta åttondelar.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Dots and rests
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · title

rows.source: Dotted notes
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: En punkt efter en not lägger till halva notvärdet. En halvnot varar två slag, så en punkterad halvnot varar tre. En punkterad fjärdedel varar ett och ett halvt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.translation: Hälften av två är ett, så punkten lägger till ett slag: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Rests
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
rows.translation: En paus är uppmätt tystnad. Varje notvärde har en motsvarande paus: en fjärdedelspaus varar ett slag, en halvpaus två. Fortsätt räkna genom dem.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
rows.translation: En fjärdedel är ett slag; punkten lägger till hälften av det.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
rows.translation: En fyrslagstakt har en halvnot och en fjärdedelsnot. Vad fyller luckan?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter rest
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A half rest
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A whole rest
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
rows.translation: 2 + 1 = 3, så ett slag återstår: en fjärdedelspaus.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Time signatures
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · title

rows.source: Reading a time signature
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
rows.translation: De två staplade siffrorna i början av ett stycke anger taktarten. Den övre räknar slag per takt. Den undre visar notvärdet för ett slag: 4 betyder fjärdedelsnot.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
rows.translation: Hur många fjärdedelsslag finns i en takt i 4/4?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
rows.translation: Övre 4 betyder fyra slag; undre 4 gör varje slag till en fjärdedelsnot.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: 3/4 time
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
rows.translation: I 3/4 har varje takt tre fjärdedelsslag. Räkna 1, 2, 3 med tyngden på 1. Det är valsens gungning.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
rows.translation: Vilken taktart går en vals oftast i?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A waltz counts in threes: 1, 2, 3.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: 6/8 time
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.translation: I 6/8 har varje takt sex åttondelar i två grupper om tre. Det känns som två stora slag, vart och ett delat i tre: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How is 6/8 usually felt?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Six equal beats
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two beats, each split in three
rows.translation: Två slag, vart och ett delat i tre
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three beats, each split in two
rows.translation: Tre slag, vart och ett delat i två
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The eighths group 1 2 3, 4 5 6, so you feel two strong pulses per bar.
rows.translation: Åttondelarna grupperas 1 2 3, 4 5 6, så du känner två starka pulsslag per takt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In 3/4, which single note fills a whole bar?
rows.translation: Vilken ensam not fyller en hel takt i 3/4?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A dotted half note
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three beats: a half note (2) plus its dot (1).
rows.translation: Tre slag: en halvnot (2) plus punkten (1).
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Rhythm challenge
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · title

rows.source: Count it, then tap it
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Note values, dots, rests and time signatures together. Count out loud as you tap; your voice keeps your hands honest.
rows.translation: Notvärden, punkter, pauser och taktarter tillsammans. Räkna högt när du knackar; rösten håller händerna i schack.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats does a whole note last in 4/4?
rows.translation: Hur många slag varar en helnot i 4/4?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Hur många sextondelar ryms på ett slag?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: What does a dot add to a note?
rows.translation: Vad lägger en punkt till en not?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Twice its value
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Half its value
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A bar of 3/4 has a quarter note and a quarter rest. What's missing?
rows.translation: En takt i 3/4 har en fjärdedelsnot och en fjärdedelspaus. Vad saknas?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Nothing
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 3/4 holds three beats; 1 + 1 = 2, so one beat remains.
rows.translation: 3/4 har tre slag; 1 + 1 = 2, så ett slag återstår.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many eighth notes are in a bar of 6/8?
rows.translation: Hur många åttondelar finns i en takt i 6/8?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Major scales and keys
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 “Major scales and keys” · title

rows.source: The whole-and-half-step recipe, four major keys, and their key signatures.
rows.translation: Receptet med hela och halva tonsteg, fyra durtonarter och deras fasta förtecken.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 “Major scales and keys” · unit summary

rows.source: A scale
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A scale is a set of notes climbing in order from a home note to the same note an octave up. C major uses only white keys: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.translation: En skala är toner som stiger i ordning från en hemmaton till samma ton en oktav upp. C-dur använder bara vita tangenter: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many different letters are in a major scale?
rows.translation: Hur många olika bokstäver finns i en durskala?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Seven letters, then the first one returns an octave higher.
rows.translation: Sju bokstäver, sedan återkommer den första en oktav högre.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Is this scale going up or down?
rows.translation: Går den här skalan upp eller ned?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Where the half steps fall
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In C major, most neighbors are a whole step apart. Only E to F and B to C are half steps. That uneven spacing gives the scale its sound.
rows.translation: I C-dur ligger de flesta granntoner ett heltonssteg isär. Bara E till F och B till C är halvtonssteg. De ojämna avstånden ger skalan dess ljud.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which steps are half steps?
rows.translation: Vilka steg är halvtonssteg i C-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to D and F to G
rows.translation: C till D och F till G
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E to F and B to C
rows.translation: E till F och B till C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: D to E and A to B
rows.translation: D till E och A till B
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E and F, and B and C, have no black key between them.
rows.translation: E och F samt B och C har ingen svart tangent emellan.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What's the home note of C major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The home note, called the tonic, gives the scale its name.
rows.translation: Hemmatonen, kallad grundton, ger skalan dess namn.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the C major scale, up from middle C.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung C-durskalan uppåt från ettstrukna C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The major scale recipe
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · title

rows.source: Whole, whole, half
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major scale follows one recipe of steps: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. Start on any note, follow it, and you build a major scale.
rows.translation: Alla durskalor följer samma stegrecept: hel, hel, halv, hel, hel, hel, halv. Börja på valfri ton och följ det så bygger du en durskala.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which is the major scale recipe? (W = whole, H = half)
rows.translation: Vilket är durskalans recept? (W = hel, H = halv)
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Hel, hel, halv, hel, hel, hel, halv.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Number the scale's notes 1 to 8. Where are the half steps?
rows.translation: Numrera skaltonerna 1 till 8. Var ligger halvtonsstegen?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, whole, then half from 3 to 4; whole, whole, whole, then half from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Hel, hel, sedan halv från 3 till 4; hel, hel, hel, sedan halv från 7 till 8.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Is this a major scale?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Starting on G, a whole step up lands on...
rows.translation: Från G landar ett heltonssteg upp på...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G to A skips one key, G♯.
rows.translation: G till A hoppar över en tangent, G♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the first four notes of D major: whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung D-durskalans fyra första toner: hel, hel, halv.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Building G major
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start on G and follow the recipe: G, A, B, C, D, E, then a whole step to F♯ and a half step home to G. G major has one sharp: F♯.
rows.translation: Börja på G och följ receptet: G, A, B, C, D, E, sedan ett heltonssteg till F♯ och ett halvtonssteg hem till G. G-dur har ett kors: F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Why does G major need F♯ instead of F?
rows.translation: Varför behöver G-dur F♯ i stället för F?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F is too low to sing
rows.translation: F är för lågt att sjunga
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sharps sound brighter
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E to F is only a half step
rows.translation: E till F är bara ett halvtonssteg
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The recipe needs a whole step from note 6 to 7, then a half step from 7 up to G.
rows.translation: Receptet kräver ett heltonssteg från ton 6 till 7, sedan ett halvtonssteg från 7 upp till G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which note is in G major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G major's seventh note is F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many sharps are in G major?
rows.translation: Hur många kors finns i G-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: None
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Just one: F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the G major scale. Remember the F♯.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung G-durskalan. Kom ihåg F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D major and F major
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · title

rows.source: D major: two sharps
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: From D, the recipe gives D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D major has two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Från D ger receptet D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D-dur har två kors: F♯ och C♯.

rows.source: From F, the recipe needs a half step from A to the fourth note, so it's B♭, not B. F major: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. One flat: B♭.
rows.translation: Från F kräver receptet ett halvtonssteg från A till fjärde tonen, alltså B♭, inte B. F-dur: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. Ett b: B♭.

rows.source: F major's fourth note is B♭, a half step above A.
rows.translation: F-durskalans fjärde ton är B♭, ett halvtonssteg över A.

rows.source: Key signatures
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · title

rows.source: Rather than writing F♯ every time, music in G major puts one sharp at the start of each line. That's the key signature: it lists the notes that are always sharp or flat.
rows.translation: I stället för att skriva F♯ varje gång sätter musik i G-dur ett kors i början av varje rad. Det är fasta förtecken: de visar vilka toner som alltid höjs eller sänks.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A key signature has one sharp, F♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: De fasta förtecknen har ett kors, F♯. Vilken durtonart är det?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G major is the major key with just F♯.
rows.translation: G-dur är durtonarten med bara F♯.

rows.source: A sharp shortcut
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sharps always appear in the same order: F♯, C♯, G♯, and so on. The last sharp is a half step below the key's name. One sharp, F♯: G major.
rows.translation: Kors kommer alltid i samma ordning: F♯, C♯, G♯ och så vidare. Sista korset ligger ett halvtonssteg under tonartens namn. Ett kors, F♯: G-dur.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A key signature has two sharps, F♯ and C♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: De fasta förtecknen har två kors, F♯ och C♯. Vilken durtonart är det?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E major
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Sista korset, C♯, ligger ett halvtonssteg under D.

rows.source: A key signature applies to every B in every octave, unless the music marks otherwise.
rows.translation: Ett fast förtecken gäller varje B i alla oktaver om inget annat anges i noterna.

rows.translation: Intervallets tal fås genom att räkna bokstavsnamn, med båda ändarna. C upp till E räknas C, D, E: tre bokstäver, alltså en ters.

rows.source: Thirds by size
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · title

rows.source: Count half steps for size
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Two intervals with the same number can differ in size. To measure exactly, count half steps. C up to E is four; C up to E♭ is three.
rows.translation: Två intervall med samma tal kan vara olika stora. Räkna halvtonssteg för att mäta exakt. C upp till E är fyra; C upp till E♭ är tre.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many half steps from D up to F?
rows.translation: Hur många halvtonssteg från D upp till F?

rows.source: D, D♯, E, F: three moves.
rows.translation: D, D♯, E, F: tre förflyttningar.

rows.source: A third of four half steps is a major third, like C to E. A third of three is a minor third, like C to E♭ or A to C.
rows.translation: En ters på fyra halvtonssteg är stor, som C till E. En ters på tre är liten, som C till E♭ eller A till C.

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · title

rows.source: Unisons, fourths, fifths and octaves are called perfect. A perfect fourth spans five half steps, a perfect fifth seven, and an octave twelve.
rows.translation: Unisoner, kvarter, kvinter och oktaver kallas rena. En ren kvart omfattar fem halvtonssteg, en ren kvint sju och en oktav tolv.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Most white-key fifths are perfect, but B up to F spans only six half steps. It's called a diminished fifth. When in doubt, count half steps.
rows.translation: De flesta kvinter på vita tangenter är rena, men B upp till F omfattar bara sex halvtonssteg. Det kallas förminskad kvint. Räkna halvtonssteg om du är osäker.

rows.translation: E, F, G, A, B, C blir en sext. Den omfattar åtta halvtonssteg, så den är liten.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Number, then size
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count letters for the number. Count half steps for the size. Together they name any interval.
rows.translation: Räkna bokstäver för talet. Räkna halvtonssteg för storleken. Tillsammans ger de alla intervall namn.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F up to A is a...
rows.translation: F upp till A är en...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, A is a third, and four half steps makes it major.
rows.translation: F, G, A är en ters och fyra halvtonssteg gör den stor.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D up to A is a...
rows.translation: D upp till A är en...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: D till A omfattar sju halvtonssteg.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: B up to D is a...
rows.translation: B upp till D är en...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B, C, D is a third of three half steps: minor.
rows.translation: B, C, D är en ters på tre halvtonssteg: liten.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major sixth?
rows.translation: Hur många halvtonssteg finns i en stor sext?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Nine
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G up to F is a...
rows.translation: G upp till F är en...

rows.source: G to F covers seven letters and ten half steps: a minor seventh.
rows.translation: G till F täcker sju bokstäver och tio halvtonssteg: en liten septima.

rows.source: Chords
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 “Chords” · title

rows.source: Stack thirds into triads, build major and minor chords, and number the chords of a key.
rows.translation: Stapla terser till treklanger, bygg dur- och mollackord och numrera tonartens ackord.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 “Chords” · unit summary

rows.source: Building a triad
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · title

rows.source: Stacking thirds
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
rows.translation: En treklang är tre toner staplade i terser. Börja på valfri ton, hoppa över en bokstav, ta nästa, hoppa igen. C, hoppa över D, E, hoppa över F, G: C E G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes make a triad built on G?
rows.translation: Vilka toner bildar en treklang på G?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G, skip A, B, skip C, D.
rows.translation: G, hoppa över A, B, hoppa över C, D.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Root, third, fifth
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.
rows.translation: Tonen som treklangen byggs på är grundtonen. Mittentonen är tersen och översta tonen kvinten, namngivna efter sina avstånd över grundtonen.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the triad F A C, which note is the root?
rows.translation: Vilken ton är grundton i treklangen F A C?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F is the bottom note the triad is built on.
rows.translation: F är den lägsta tonen som treklangen byggs på.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In the triad D F A, which note is the fifth?
rows.translation: Vilken ton är kvinten i treklangen D F A?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D up to A is a fifth: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.translation: D upp till A är en kvint: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Using only white keys, which triad is built on E?
rows.translation: Vilken treklang byggs på E med bara vita tangenter?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E, skip F, G, skip A, B.
rows.translation: E, hoppa över F, G, hoppa över A, B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the C triad one note at a time: C, E, G.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung C-treklangen en ton i taget: C, E, G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Major and minor triads
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · title

rows.source: Major triads
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
rows.translation: En durtreklang har en stor ters nederst, fyra halvtonssteg, och en liten ters ovanpå. C E G är dur. Det är även F A C och G B D.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Byt plats på terserna så får du moll: liten ters nederst, stor ters ovanpå. Sänk mittentonen i C-dur så får du C-moll: C E♭ G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes spell D minor?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to F is a minor third; F to A is a major third.
rows.translation: D till F är en liten ters; F till A är en stor ters.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which notes spell E major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E to G♯ is a major third; G♯ to B is a minor third.
rows.translation: E till G♯ är en stor ters; G♯ till B är en liten ters.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Is A C E major or minor?
rows.translation: Är A C E dur eller moll?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A to C is a minor third, three half steps.
rows.translation: A till C är en liten ters, tre halvtonssteg.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing A minor one note at a time: A, C, E.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung A-moll en ton i taget: A, C, E.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The chords of a key
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · title

rows.source: Chords from a scale
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Build a triad on each note of a scale, using only that scale's notes, and you get the key's family of chords. C major has seven, one per note.
rows.translation: Bygg en treklang på varje skalton med bara skalans toner så får du tonartens ackordfamilj. C-dur har sju, en per ton.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on D?
rows.translation: Vilken treklang byggs på D med bara C-durtoner?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D diminished
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: D F A: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: D F A: en liten ters, sedan en stor.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on G?
rows.translation: Vilken treklang byggs på G med bara C-durtoner?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G diminished
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G B D: a major third, then a minor third.
rows.translation: G B D: en stor ters, sedan en liten.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The diminished chord
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The triad on B is different: B D F. Both thirds are minor, so it's a diminished triad. It sounds tense and wants to move.
rows.translation: Treklangen på B är annorlunda: B D F. Båda terserna är små, så treklangen är förminskad. Den låter spänd och vill vidare.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which chords are major?
rows.translation: Vilka ackord är dur i C-dur?

rows.source: C E G, F A C and G B D each have a major third on the bottom.
rows.translation: C E G, F A C och G B D har alla en stor ters nederst.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on A?
rows.translation: Vilken treklang byggs på A med bara C-durtoner?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A diminished
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A C E: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: A C E: en liten ters, sedan en stor.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the diminished triad on B: B, D, F.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung den förminskade treklangen på B: B, D, F.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Roman numerals
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · title

rows.source: Numbering chords
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
rows.translation: Musiker numrerar tonartens ackord med romerska siffror: I för ackordet på ton 1, upp till vii för ton 7. Stora bokstäver betyder dur, små moll och ° förminskat.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The major key pattern
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.
rows.translation: Varje durtonart följer ett mönster: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. I C-dur blir det C, D-moll, E-moll, F, G, A-moll och B-förminskat.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Vilket ackord är IV i C-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The fourth note of C major is F.
rows.translation: Fjärde tonen i C-dur är F.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In C major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Vilket ackord är vi i C-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The sixth note is A, and lowercase vi means minor.
rows.translation: Sjätte tonen är A och små bokstäver i vi betyder moll.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In G major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Vilket ackord är V i G-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G, A, B, C, D. The fifth note is D, and V is major.
rows.translation: Räkna upp från G: G, A, B, C, D. Femte tonen är D och V är dur.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Why is ii written in lowercase?
rows.translation: Varför skrivs ii med små bokstäver?

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · title

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack thirds, check their sizes, then place the chord in its key: major on I, IV and V, minor on ii, iii and vi, diminished on vii°.
rows.translation: Stapla terser, kontrollera storleken och placera ackordet i tonarten: dur på I, IV och V, moll på ii, iii och vi, förminskat på vii°.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: In F major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Vilket ackord är V i F-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: the fifth note is C.

rows.source: Progressions
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 “Progressions” · title

rows.source: How chords move in songs: I–IV–V, the pop loop, ii–V–I, the 12-bar blues and cadences.
rows.translation: Så rör sig ackord i låtar: I–IV–V, popslingan, ii–V–I, 12-taktersblues och kadenser.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 “Progressions” · unit summary

rows.source: I, IV and V
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · title

rows.source: Three chords
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Countless folk, rock and country songs use just three chords: I, IV and V. In C major, that's C, F and G. Together they hold every note of the scale.
rows.translation: Otaliga folk-, rock- och countrylåtar använder bara tre ackord: I, IV och V. I C-dur är det C, F och G. Tillsammans har de alla skalans toner.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, what are I, IV and V?
rows.translation: Vad är I, IV och V i G-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G, B and D
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G, A and D
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count up from G: note 1 is G, note 4 is C, note 5 is D.
rows.translation: Räkna upp från G: ton 1 är G, ton 4 är C, ton 5 är D.

rows.source: Does this end on the home chord?

rows.source: Home, away, and back
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.
rows.translation: I känns som hemma. IV går bort. V bygger spänning som drar tillbaka till I. Resan ut och tillbaka formar en väldig mängd låtar.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord pulls most strongly back to I?
rows.translation: Vilket ackord drar starkast tillbaka till I?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: V builds tension that resolves to I.
rows.translation: V bygger spänning som upplöses i I.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In D major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Vilket ackord är IV i D-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D, E, F♯, G: the fourth note is G.
rows.translation: D, E, F♯, G: fjärde tonen är G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I, IV, V, I in C: C, F, G, C.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung grundtonerna i I, IV, V, I i C: C, F, G, C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The pop progression
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · title

rows.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.
rows.translation: Den här fyrackordsslingan finns under mängder av poplåtar. I C-dur är det C, G, A-moll, F. Mollackordet vi ger lite skugga innan IV lyfter tillbaka mot hemmet.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G: I is G, V is D, vi is E minor, IV is C.
rows.translation: I G: I är G, V är D, vi är E-moll, IV är C.

rows.source: Same chords, new start
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start the same loop on vi and you get vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. The chords are identical, but beginning on minor makes it sound more serious.
rows.translation: Börja samma slinga på vi så får du vi–IV–I–V: A-moll, F, C, G. Ackorden är identiska, men början i moll gör ljudet allvarligare.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In F major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Vilket ackord är vi i F-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: the sixth note is D, and vi is minor.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: sjätte tonen är D och vi är moll.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–V–vi–IV in C: C, G, A, F.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung grundtonerna i I–V–vi–IV i C: C, G, A, F.

rows.source: The jazz workhorse
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
rows.translation: ii–V–I är jazzens vanligaste ackordföljd. I C-dur: D-moll, G, C. Varje grundton faller en kvint till nästa, så rörelsen känns som att komma hem.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D minor, G, C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E minor, G, C

rows.source: ii is D minor, V is G, and I is C.
rows.translation: ii är D-moll, V är G och I är C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Add sevenths
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players usually add sevenths: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. The extra notes make each move even smoother. The roots and the trip home stay the same.
rows.translation: Jazzmusiker lägger oftast till septimor: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. Extratonerna gör varje rörelse ännu mjukare. Grundtonerna och hemresan är desamma.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In F major, what is ii–V–I?

rows.source: G minor, C, F

rows.translation: D ned till G, sedan G ned till C: en kvint varje gång.

rows.source: Twelve bars
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
rows.translation: 12-taktersbluesen är ett ackordschema på tolv takter bakom otaliga blues-, rock- och jazzlåtar. Den använder I, IV och V, ofta alla som dominantseptimackord för bluesig skärpa.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Is this the 12-bar blues?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: The plan
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.
rows.translation: Fyra takter I. Två IV, två I. En V, en IV, två I. Sedan upprepas det. I A: A7 fyra gånger, D7 två, A7 två, E7, D7, A7 två.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hur många takter I inleder en 12-taktersblues?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Four bars of I, then IV arrives in bar 5.
rows.translation: Fyra takter I, sedan kommer IV i takt 5.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Bar 9 is the one bar of V, before IV in bar 10.
rows.translation: Takt 9 är den enda takten V, före IV i takt 10.

rows.translation: Vilka är de tre bluesackorden i E?

rows.translation: I E är I E, IV A och V B.

rows.source: Cadences
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · title

rows.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
rows.translation: En kadens är ackordrörelsen som avslutar en fras, som ett skiljetecken. V till I är starkast, en punkt. Det kallas autentisk kadens.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does this phrase sound finished?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Other endings
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.
rows.translation: IV till I är en plagal kadens, det mjuka amen i slutet av många psalmer. Ett stopp på V är en halvkadens, som ett komma. V till vi är bedräglig: du väntar hemmet och får en överraskning.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Rhythm
rows.context: Rhythm course · title

rows.source: Feel the beat, count it, and tap it in time
rows.translation: Känn pulsen, räkna den och knacka i takt
rows.context: Rhythm course · course subtitle

rows.source: Find the pulse, count to four, and tap in time.
rows.translation: Hitta pulsen, räkna till fyra och knacka i takt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 “The beat” · unit summary

rows.source: Find the pulse
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · title

rows.source: The beat is a steady pulse
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
rows.translation: Slaget är den jämna puls du stampar foten till. Den rusar eller sackar aldrig, som steg på en lugn promenad. Varje rytm vilar ovanpå den.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tap with the click
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
rows.translation: Håll fingertoppen precis över skärmen och knacka när klicket hörs. Låt den studsa från glaset som en trumpinne. Sikta på att landa med klicket, inte efter.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How does a beat feel?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Steady and even
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Fast, then slow
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Loud, then quiet
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
rows.translation: Pulsen håller samma avstånd mellan slagen, som en tickande klocka.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many clicks did you hear?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count to four
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · title

rows.source: Count out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
rows.translation: Det mesta av musiken grupperar slag i fyror. Räkna 1, 2, 3, 4 högt med klicket och börja sedan om på 1. Siffrorna hjälper händerna hålla takten.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bars and beat 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
rows.translation: En takt är en grupp slag. Här har varje takt fyra slag, skrivet 4/4. Slag 1 börjar varje takt, så betona det lite när du räknar.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
rows.translation: Det starka klicket är slag 1. Hur många slag finns i varje takt?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Which beat starts every bar?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Beat 2
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
rows.translation: Räkningen börjar om på 1 i början av varje takt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Quarter notes and longer
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · title

rows.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
rows.translation: En ton som varar ett slag är en fjärdedelsnot. Fyra fyller en takt i 4/4, så att knacka på varje slag är att knacka fjärdedelar.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count more than you tap
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
rows.translation: Knacka nu bara på 1 och 3. Varje knackning är en halvnot, två slag lång. Fortsätt räkna alla fyra; slagen du hoppar över finns fortfarande.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
rows.translation: Du knackar på 1 och 3. Vad händer på 2 och 4?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: You keep counting
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The music stops
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: You tap twice as fast
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
rows.translation: Pulsen stannar aldrig. Du räknar genom slagen du inte knackar.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A whole note: just beat 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
rows.translation: En helnot varar alla fyra slag. Knacka en gång på 1 och räkna 2, 3, 4 tyst så att nästa 1 landar i tid.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
rows.translation: Tempo är hur snabbt pulsen går, räknat i slag per minut, bpm. Vid 60 bpm kommer slaget en gång per sekund, som en klocka.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
rows.translation: Hur ofta kommer slaget vid 60 bpm?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Twice a second
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Once a second
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Once every two seconds
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
rows.translation: 60 slag på 60 sekunder är ett slag varje sekund.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Smaller as it speeds up
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
rows.translation: Snabbare tempo kräver mindre ansträngning, inte mer. Håll handen lös och knacka från knogen, inte handleden eller axeln.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
rows.translation: Tempot ökar. Vad ska dina knackningar göra?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Get bigger and harder
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Wait a little behind the click
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stay small and light
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
rows.translation: Små, avslappnade rörelser är snabbare och lättare att hålla jämna.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Steady hands
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
rows.translation: Utmaningen blandar slag, takter, längre toner och tempo. Räkna högt hela vägen och håll knackningarna små och avslappnade.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
rows.translation: Vilken not varar en hel takt i 4/4?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: En helnot varar fyra slag, hela takten i 4/4.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What does 90 bpm mean?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: 90 beats every minute
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
