rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
rows.translation: Högt do, sol, mi, do: tillbaka ned.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
rows.translation: Vad är intervallet från do till nästa do?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A fifth
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A third
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Do to the next do spans eight scale notes: an octave.
rows.translation: Do till nästa do omfattar åtta skaltoner: en oktav.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.
rows.translation: Fem upphovsrättsfria melodier, utan ackord, i lugnt tempo.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 “Melodies” · unit summary

rows.source: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · title

rows.source: A tune you already know
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
rows.translation: Den traditionella melodin hoppar upp och går sedan stegvis hem. Sjung på ”loo” och ge varje upprepad ton en ny början.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
rows.translation: Inledningssprånget: C upp till G, steg till A, tillbaka till G.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
rows.translation: Mellanfrasen: går den upp eller ned?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Middle phrase
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Beethoven's famous tune
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
rows.translation: Melodin ur Beethovens nionde symfoni går nästan helt stegvis. Håll den mjuk och jämn som en promenad upp och ned för en trappa.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
rows.translation: Melodins fem toner: F upp till C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
rows.translation: Första frasen slutar med en punkterad not. Hur känns den?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two equal notes
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
rows.translation: Den punkterade tonen hålls längre, sedan leder en kort ton in i den sista.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Start with a pickup
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
rows.translation: Den traditionella skotska melodin börjar med en upptakt, en ton före första hela takten. Sjung den lätt och betona sedan nästa ton.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
rows.translation: Klättringen i tredje takten: F, A, C, upp till D.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What is a pickup?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The loudest note of a song
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A rest at the end
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A note before the first full bar
rows.translation: En ton före första hela takten
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A pickup leads into beat 1 of the first full bar.
rows.translation: En upptakt leder in till slag 1 i första hela takten.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
rows.translation: Den amerikanska psalmmelodin från tidigt 1800-tal går i 3/4: räkna 1, 2, 3. Långa toner övergår ofta i ett snabbt par, så håll paret lätt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
rows.translation: Den snabba vändningen: F, upp till A, tillbaka till F.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
rows.translation: Hur många slag finns i varje takt i psalmen?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
rows.translation: Den går i 3/4: tre slag per takt med tyngden på 1.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A slow river song
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
rows.translation: Den amerikanska folkvisan från 1800-talet går långsamt med stora språng. Andas vid varje paus och hör varje språng innan du sjunger.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
rows.translation: Inledningssprånget: lågt G upp till C. Alla oktaver räknas.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
rows.translation: Det stora språnget: G upp till högt C, sedan stegvis ned.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
rows.translation: Var ska du andas i den här låten?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: At the rests between phrases
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Never; sing it in one breath
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.
rows.translation: Pauserna markerar frassluten. Andas där så att varje rad får fullt stöd.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Traditional (19th century)
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: Five tunes back to back, one phrase each. Breathe at every rest, and give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Fem melodier efter varandra, en fras var. Andas vid varje paus och ge upprepade toner en ny början.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which of these songs is in 3/4?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Amazing Grace counts 1, 2, 3 in every bar.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace räknas 1, 2, 3 i varje takt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Control
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 “Control” · title

rows.source: Hold notes steady, shape loud and soft, and warm up well.
rows.translation: Håll tonerna jämna, forma starkt och svagt och värm upp ordentligt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 “Control” · unit summary

rows.source: Hold it steady
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · title

rows.source: Steady air, steady pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
rows.translation: Tonhöjden driver när luften bakom ändras. Behåll ett lågt, jämnt andetag och se tonen förbli centrerad från början till slut.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold G and keep it centered.
rows.translation: Håll G och behåll tonens centrum.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Finish before you're empty
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
rows.translation: Toner sjunker ofta för lågt när luften tar slut. Sluta lite tidigare och ta sedan ett nytt lågt andetag.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?
rows.translation: Dina långa toner sjunker på slutet. Vad hjälper?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: End the note sooner and breathe
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze out the last air
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sing the end louder
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.
rows.translation: Tonhöjden sjunker när luften tryter. Ett lite tidigare slut håller hela tonen ren.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Long and steady
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Climbing long notes
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Vibrato basics
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · title

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
rows.translation: Vibrato är en mjuk, regelbunden våg i tonhöjden, cirka fem till sju gånger per sekund. Det växer ur avslappnad hals och jämn andning, inte ur skakning.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does healthy vibrato come from?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Shaking your jaw
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pulsing your belly
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A relaxed throat and steady breath
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.
rows.translation: Vibrato kommer när rösten är fri och har stöd. Att tvinga fram det från käken eller magen ger ett svaj.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Straight tone first
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
rows.translation: Lär dig hålla en rak, jämn ton innan du jagar vibrato. När rösten är avslappnad och har stöd kommer vibrato ofta av sig självt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
rows.translation: Ett rakt, jämnt A. Ingen våg, bara en tydlig linje.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
rows.translation: Vilket är bästa första målet för en ny sångare?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A wide, fast wobble
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A steady, straight tone
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: As much vibrato as possible
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A steady tone is the foundation. Vibrato that grows from it sounds natural.
rows.translation: En jämn ton är grunden. Vibrato som växer ur den låter naturligt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Straight and steady
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Dynamics: loud and soft
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
rows.translation: Dynamik är hur starkt eller svagt du sjunger. Öka styrkan med mer andningsenergi, inte genom att klämma i halsen. Tonhöjden ska ligga kvar.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Sjung E svagt och sedan starkare på samma tonhöjd.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?
rows.translation: Vad kan hända med tonhöjden när du sjunger starkare?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It can drift sharp
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It drops an octave
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Nothing ever changes
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
rows.translation: Extra tryck tenderar att höja tonen och mycket svaga toner kan sjunka för lågt. Håll ögonen på tonen i båda fallen.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Swell and fade
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
rows.translation: En svällning går från svagt till starkare och tillbaka på ett andetag. Börja tyst, väx varsamt och tona sedan bort, allt på samma tonhöjd.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
rows.translation: Sväll på G: svagt, starkare, svagt. Behåll tonens centrum.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Swell each note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Your warm-up routine
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · title

rows.source: Five minutes before you sing
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
rows.translation: En kort uppvärmning sätter igång rösten varsamt: andas lågt, nynna, läppdallra och sjung en skala. Börja mitt i omfånget och håll det bekvämt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?
rows.translation: Rösten känns trött efter övningen. Vad är bäst?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Push through another hour
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Rest it and sip water
rows.translation: Vila rösten och drick lite vatten
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
rows.translation: Vila hjälper en trött röst att återhämta sig. Om hesheten varar i några veckor, kontakta läkare.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Control check
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · title

rows.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
rows.translation: Värm upp först. Håll sedan varje ton jämn, forma svagt och starkt och andas innan luften tar slut.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is vibrato?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A regular wave in pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Singing slightly flat
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A very loud note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, even wave around the note, a few times a second.
rows.translation: Vibrato är en mjuk, jämn våg runt tonen några gånger per sekund.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: To sing louder, what do you add?
rows.translation: Vad lägger du till för att sjunga starkare?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Throat squeeze
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Breath energy
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Jaw tension
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Breath energy makes a bigger sound without strain.
rows.translation: Andningsenergi ger större ljud utan ansträngning.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play the melody, or strum the chords and sing
rows.translation: Spela melodin eller kompa med ackord och sjung
rows.context: Songs course · course subtitle

rows.source: First songs
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 “First songs” · title

rows.source: Six famous tunes, one note at a time, on the top strings. Slow tempos, big wins.
rows.translation: Sex kända melodier, en ton i taget, på de översta strängarna. Lugnt tempo, stora framsteg.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 “First songs” · unit summary

rows.source: Edison's first recording
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: År 1877 reciterade Thomas Edison den här ramsan för att prova sin nya fonograf. Melodin använder C och D på sträng 2, sedan öppet E och G på band 3 på sträng 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: öppen sträng 1, sedan sträng 2 på band 3 och 1 och tillbaka.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D på band 3 på sträng 2. Sedan öppet E och G på band 3 på sträng 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A French folk tune
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Melodin trycktes först i Frankrike 1761 och Mozart skrev senare tolv variationer över den. Den hoppar upp och går sedan stegvis ned över sträng 2 och 3.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
rows.translation: Öppet G, ett språng upp till D på band 3 på sträng 2, öppet E och tillbaka till D.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
rows.translation: Gå ned parvis: C på band 1, öppet B, A på band 2 på sträng 3, öppet G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which other song uses this same tune?
rows.translation: Vilken annan låt använder samma melodi?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Jingle Bells
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The alphabet song
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The alphabet song and Baa, Baa, Black Sheep both borrow this French melody.
rows.translation: Alfabetssången och Baa, Baa, Black Sheep lånar båda den här franska melodin.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Opening phrase
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Beethoven's Ninth
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
rows.translation: Beethoven avslutade sin nionde symfoni 1824 och melodin är nu EU:s hymn. Här spelar du hela melodin, även mellandelen.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
rows.translation: Inledningen: E E F G G F E D, ett steg i taget.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Two notes in one beat
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
rows.translation: I mellandelen delar E och F ett slag. Räkna ett, två-och, tre, fyra och spela E på två och F på och.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: Mitten: snabba E F-par på sträng 1, sedan ned till öppet G på sträng 3.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The middle section
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Frère Jacques
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · title

rows.source: A tune that chases itself
rows.translation: En melodi som jagar sig själv
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
rows.translation: Broder Jakob är en fransk kanon, först tryckt runt 1780: en andra musiker börjar samma melodi två takter senare och stämmorna passar ihop.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a round, the second player…
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Plays a different tune
rows.translation: Spelar den andra en annan melodi
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Starts the same tune later
rows.translation: Börjar den andra samma melodi senare
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plays the tune backward
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Everyone plays the same melody, each starting a little later. The phrases are built to fit on top of each other.
rows.translation: Alla spelar samma melodi men börjar lite senare än varandra. Fraserna är byggda för att passa ovanpå varandra.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The quick part: D E D C on strings 2 and 1, then B and G.
rows.translation: Den snabba delen: D E D C på sträng 2 och 1, sedan B och G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The quick part
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: The ending dips from open G to open D on string 4, then comes back.
rows.translation: Slutet går från öppet G ned till öppet D på sträng 4 och återvänder sedan.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Traditional (France, about 1780)
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: A sleigh-ride song
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: James Lord Pierpont published this song in 1857 as One Horse Open Sleigh. You'll play its famous chorus, all on strings 1 and 2.
rows.translation: James Lord Pierpont gav ut låten 1857 som One Horse Open Sleigh. Du spelar den berömda refrängen, helt på sträng 1 och 2.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3, down to C and D on string 2, then home to E.
rows.translation: Öppet E, G på band 3, ned till C och D på sträng 2, sedan hem till E.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Long, then quick
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In that phrase, C rings for a beat and a half and D slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: I frasen klingar C i ett och ett halvt slag och D kommer in på och efter fyra. Räkna ett, två, tre, fyra-och.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The second line sits on F at fret 1, then settles onto open E.
rows.translation: Andra raden ligger på F på band 1 och landar sedan på öppet E.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Verse
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard after Louis Armstrong recorded it in 1938. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Den traditionella spiritualen blev en jazzstandard efter Louis Armstrongs inspelning 1938. Den använder C, D, E, F och G på sträng 2 och 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-saints “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: C on string 2, then E, F and G climbing string 1.
rows.translation: Inledningen: C på sträng 2, sedan E, F och G uppför sträng 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-saints “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: First songs medley
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · title

rows.source: Six songs, one sitting
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new notes here: all six tunes from this unit, each a little faster than before. Name the opening by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Inga nya toner här: alla sex melodier från enheten, lite snabbare än förut. Känn igen inledningen på gehör och spela sedan.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Folk favorites
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 “Folk favorites” · title

rows.source: Campfire songs and a sea song, with easy chords to strum on the simplest ones.
rows.translation: Lägereldslåtar och en sjömansvisa, med enkla ackord att kompa de lättaste med.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 “Folk favorites” · unit summary

rows.source: A Gold Rush anthem
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1848, and gold seekers heading to California made it their anthem. The verse sits on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster gav ut låten 1848 och guldsökare på väg till Kalifornien gjorde den till sin sång. Versen ligger på sträng 3, 2 och 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E, then back down to open G and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Öppet B, D på band 3, öppet E, sedan ned till öppet G och A på band 2.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The last bar: B B A A, then home to open G.
rows.translation: Sista takten: B B A A, sedan hem till öppet G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Two chords: G and D7
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: G sounds like home, and D7 pulls back toward it. The verse is three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: G låter som hemma och D7 drar tillbaka dit. Versen är tre takter G, en D7, två G, sedan D7 och G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Same chords, new race
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this racing song in 1850, two years after Oh! Susanna. It uses the same notes and the same two chords.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster skrev den här kapplöpningssången 1850, två år efter Oh! Susanna. Den använder samma toner och samma två ackord.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D D B D, up to open E, then D and B. Strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: D D B D, upp till öppet E, sedan D och B. Sträng 2 och 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Twice in the first line, a quick B leads into an A that rings for three beats. Pick the A once and let it ring.
rows.translation: Två gånger i första raden leder ett snabbt B till ett A som klingar i tre slag. Slå an A en gång och låt det klinga.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Down to string 4
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This farmyard song was first printed in 1917, but people sang versions of it long before. Its tune reaches down to D and E on string 4.
rows.translation: Gårdssången trycktes först 1917, men versioner sjöngs långt tidigare. Melodin når ned till D och E på sträng 4.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open G three times, down to open D, E at fret 2 on string 4, back to D.
rows.translation: Öppet G tre gånger, ned till öppet D, E på band 2 på sträng 4, tillbaka till D.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then up: open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, and home to open G.
rows.translation: Sedan upp: öppet B två gånger, A på band 2 på sträng 3 och hem till öppet G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Count in twos
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Here each chord lasts two beats, so the strum counts one, two. The order is G, G, C, G, then G, D7, G, G. Change early.
rows.translation: Här varar varje ackord två slag, så kompet räknas ett, två. Ordningen är G, G, C, G, sedan G, D7, G, G. Byt tidigt.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Traditional (printed 1917)
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: A song that changed sides
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: British soldiers first sang this tune to mock American colonists. By the end of the Revolution, the Americans had made it their own.
rows.translation: Brittiska soldater sjöng först melodin för att håna amerikanska kolonister. Vid revolutionens slut hade amerikanerna gjort den till sin egen.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C C D E, C E D, then a drop to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: C C D E, C E D, sedan ned till öppet G på sträng 3.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The first half ends on B. How does that feel?
rows.translation: Första halvan slutar på B. Hur känns det?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Unfinished, like a question
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B sits just below C and leans toward it. The second half answers by landing on C.
rows.translation: B ligger precis under C och drar ditåt. Andra halvan svarar genom att landa på C.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The last line: down from F on string 1, dip to open G, then climb back to C.
rows.translation: Sista raden: ned från F på sträng 1, ned till öppet G och sedan upp till C igen.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The chorus sits low: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, then F and E on string 4 and C on string 5.
rows.translation: Refrängen ligger lågt: A på band 2 på sträng 3, öppet B, sedan F och E på sträng 4 och C på sträng 5.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Traditional (18th century)
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: From 1861 to rock and roll
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: George Poulton published this ballad in 1861. Nearly a century later, its melody became the tune of Love Me Tender.
rows.translation: George Poulton gav ut balladen 1861. Nästan ett sekel senare blev dess melodi melodin till Love Me Tender.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up to C, down to open B and back, then D, a dip to A, and D again.
rows.translation: Upp till C, ned till öppet B och tillbaka, sedan D, ned till A och D igen.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Let it sing
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Aura Lee is a slow ballad. Keep each finger down until the next note sounds, so the notes join smoothly.
rows.translation: Aura Lee är en långsam ballad. Håll varje finger nere tills nästa ton ljuder så att tonerna binds ihop mjukt.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The high part: open E, F at fret 1, then down to D, A, and D again.
rows.translation: Den höga delen: öppet E, F på band 1, sedan ned till D, A och D igen.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The high part
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A sailor's sweetheart
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This song from the north of England is about Bobby Shafto, gone to sea. Its words were in print by 1805, and fiddlers played its tune for dances by 1770.
rows.translation: Sången från norra England handlar om Bobby Shafto som farit till sjöss. Texten fanns i tryck senast 1805 och spelmän spelade melodin till dans senast 1770.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, back to B and open G, then B, D and B again.
rows.translation: Öppet B, D på band 3, tillbaka till B och öppet G, sedan B, D och B igen.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: F sharp with finger 4
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The second line dips to F sharp: string 4, fret 4, with your little finger. Keep your hand over the first four frets so it's ready.
rows.translation: Andra raden går ned till Fiss: sträng 4, band 4, med lillfingret. Håll handen över de fyra första banden så att den är redo.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, A, down to F sharp, and back up.
rows.translation: A på band 2 på sträng 3, C på band 1 på sträng 2, A, ned till Fiss och tillbaka upp.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Step, step, hold
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The first three lines end the same way: two notes of one beat, then one of two beats. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.translation: De tre första raderna slutar likadant: två toner på ett slag var, sedan en på två slag. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G and D7 again
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 9 (explain) · title

rows.source: The verse needs only the two chords from Oh! Susanna: two bars of G, two of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Versen behöver bara de två ackorden från Oh! Susanna: två takter G, två D7, två G, sedan D7 och G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 9 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Traditional (Northumbrian Minstrelsy, 1882)
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: Folk medley
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · title

rows.source: Campfire set list
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new notes or chords: all six songs from this unit, one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Inga nya toner eller ackord: alla sex låtar från enheten efter varandra, lite snabbare än förut.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Classical themes I
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 “Classical themes I” · title

rows.source: Famous themes by Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg and Beethoven, in first position.
rows.translation: Kända teman av Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg och Beethoven i första position.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 “Classical themes I” · unit summary

rows.source: Canon in D
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · title

rows.source: Eight notes, over and over
rows.translation: Åtta toner, om och om igen
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Johann Pachelbel wrote this canon over 300 years ago. Its bass repeats the same eight notes the whole way through while violins weave melodies above.
rows.translation: Johann Pachelbel skrev kanonen för över 300 år sedan. Basen upprepar samma åtta toner hela vägen medan violiner väver melodier ovanpå.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The bass, moved up an octave: D, A, B, F sharp, G, D, G, A.
rows.translation: Basen, en oktav upp: D, A, B, Fiss, G, D, G, A.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What does the bass do all through the Canon?
rows.translation: Vad gör basen genom hela kanonen?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Repeats the same eight notes
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plays a new tune each time
rows.translation: Spelar en ny melodi varje gång
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stays silent until the end
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A repeating bass like this is called a ground. Everything else in the piece is built on top of it.
rows.translation: En sådan upprepad bas kallas ostinat bas. Allt annat i stycket byggs ovanpå den.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The bass, twice
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Sharps on the way down
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above its letter. The melody uses C sharp on string 2, fret 2, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Ett kors är ett band över sin bokstav. Melodin använder Ciss på sträng 2, band 2 och Fiss på sträng 4, band 4. Nå den med lillfingret.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first violin line: down from F sharp on string 1, then back up to C sharp.
rows.translation: Första violinraden: ned från Fiss på sträng 1 och tillbaka upp till Ciss.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The melody
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Largo, New World Symphony
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · title

rows.source: A melody from America
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Antonín Dvořák wrote this theme for English horn in 1893, in his Symphony From the New World, while he was living in New York.
rows.translation: Antonín Dvořák skrev temat för engelskt horn 1893 i symfonin Från nya världen, medan han bodde i New York.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, back to E, then D and C on string 2.
rows.translation: Öppet E, G på band 3 på sträng 1, tillbaka till E, sedan D och C på sträng 2.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Most bars open with a long note and a quick one. Count one, two-and, three: the quick note lands on the and of two.
rows.translation: De flesta takter börjar med en lång ton och en snabb. Räkna ett, två-och, tre: den snabba tonen landar på och efter två.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The ending: D, E, D, then settle on C and let it ring.
rows.translation: Slutet: D, E, D, landa sedan på C och låt det klinga.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Bridge
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.source: A gift for a baby
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Johannes Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868 for a friend's newborn son. It sways in three, like a cradle: a long note, then two quick ones.
rows.translation: Johannes Brahms skrev vaggvisan 1868 till en väns nyfödde son. Den gungar i tretakt som en vagga: en lång ton, sedan två snabba.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening rocks between open B and D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Inledningen gungar mellan öppet B och D på band 3 på sträng 2.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open G on string 3, then the same note an octave higher: G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: Öppet G på sträng 3, sedan samma ton en oktav högre: G på band 3 på sträng 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From Bach's family notebook
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This minuet appears in a 1725 notebook Bach gave his wife, Anna Magdalena. Scholars now credit it to his fellow composer Christian Petzold.
rows.translation: Menuetten finns i en notbok från 1725 som Bach gav sin fru Anna Magdalena. Forskare tillskriver den nu kompositörskollegan Christian Petzold.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, then climb from open G: A, B, C, D. Then two open Gs.
rows.translation: D på band 3 på sträng 2, klättra sedan från öppet G: A, B, C, D. Sedan två öppna G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. Most bars start with a long beat, then quick pairs: one, two-and, three-and.
rows.translation: En menuett är en dans i tretakt. De flesta takter börjar med ett långt slag och snabba par: ett, två-och, tre-och.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E, back to C and D on string 2, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Öppet E, tillbaka till C och D på sträng 2, sedan E, Fiss och G på sträng 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The ending: A B A G, then F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, and home to G.
rows.translation: Slutet: A B A G, sedan Fiss på band 4 på sträng 4 och hem till G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The second section starts low: open B, A, open D, then C sharp at fret 4 and B at fret 2 on string 5, and open A.
rows.translation: Andra delen börjar lågt: öppet B, A, öppet D, sedan Ciss på band 4 och B på band 2 på sträng 5 samt öppet A.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In the Hall of the Mountain King
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · title

rows.source: The trolls' march
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Grieg wrote this for the play Peer Gynt in 1875. It pictures trolls in their king's hall, and it starts quietly and keeps speeding up.
rows.translation: Grieg skrev stycket för pjäsen Peer Gynt 1875. Det skildrar troll i kungens sal, börjar svagt och ökar hela tiden tempot.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Climb from open string 6: F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, open A, B at fret 2.
rows.translation: Klättra från öppen sträng 6: Fiss på band 2, G på band 3, öppet A, B på band 2.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The creeping part: A sharp at fret 1 on string 5, then open A with F at fret 1 on string 6.
rows.translation: Den smygande delen: Aiss på band 1 på sträng 5, sedan öppet A med F på band 1 på sträng 6.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where is A sharp on string 5?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Open
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above A, and A is open string 5. So A sharp is fret 1.
rows.translation: Aiss är ett band över A och A är öppen sträng 5. Alltså ligger Aiss på band 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: First two bars
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: The theme
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Twice, a little faster
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Up a fifth
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: Theme up a fifth
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.source: Theme up an octave
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.source: Published 40 years late
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this piano piece in 1810, but it wasn't published until 1867, forty years after he died. This simplified version keeps the famous opening.
rows.translation: Beethoven skrev pianostycket 1810 men det gavs inte ut förrän 1867, fyrtio år efter hans död. Den förenklade versionen behåller den berömda inledningen.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Rock between open E and D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, then walk down B, D, C to A.
rows.translation: Gunga mellan öppet E och Diss på band 4 på sträng 2, gå sedan ned B, D, C till A.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Quick notes in threes
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each bar has three beats. After the long A comes a short rest, then three quick notes climb: C, E, A. Lift your finger for the rest, but keep counting.
rows.translation: Varje takt har tre slag. Efter långa A kommer en kort paus, sedan stiger tre snabba toner: C, E, A. Lyft fingret i pausen men fortsätt räkna.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, then C on string 5, E and A. Then B, E, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, and B.
rows.translation: A, sedan C på sträng 5, E och A. Sedan B, E, Giss på band 1 på sträng 3 och B.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The opening
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: The middle: each phrase dips to a low note, then steps down. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
rows.translation: Mitten: varje fras går ned till en låg ton och sedan stegvis ned. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-fur-elise “Für Elise” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Classical medley
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · title

rows.source: A short recital
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new notes: the six themes from this unit, from Pachelbel to Beethoven, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Inga nya toner: enhetens sex teman från Pachelbel till Beethoven, lite snabbare än förut.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which piece starts like this?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Which of these pieces is in three?
rows.translation: Vilket av styckena går i tretakt?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. The Canon and the trolls' march both count in four.
rows.translation: En menuett är en dans i tretakt. Kanonen och trollens marsch räknas båda i fyra.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · challenge song-medley-classical-1 “Classical medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Hymns and Americana
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 “Hymns and Americana” · title

rows.source: A Gold Rush ballad, two beloved hymns and a Shaker song from America's songbook.
rows.translation: En guldruschballad, två älskade psalmer och en shakersång ur Amerikas sångbok.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 “Hymns and Americana” · unit summary

rows.source: A Gold Rush ballad
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This American song was published in 1884 and looks back to the California Gold Rush of 1849. It's in three, on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Den amerikanska sången gavs ut 1884 och blickar tillbaka mot Kaliforniens guldrusch 1849. Den går i tretakt på sträng 3, 2 och 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Clementine starts with two quick notes before beat one. What are they called?
rows.translation: Clementine börjar med två snabba toner före första slaget. Vad kallas de?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A pickup
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A rest
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they fall on the and of beat three.
rows.translation: En upptakt är några toner som leder in till första starka slaget. Här ligger de på och efter tredje slaget.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The turn in the middle: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D, then back up to F.
rows.translation: Vändningen i mitten: G på band 3 på sträng 1, ned till D och tillbaka upp till F.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-clementine “Clementine” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Words from 1779, tune from 1829
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-amazing-grace “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: John Newton wrote the words in 1779. The tune, called New Britain, was first printed in 1829 and joined to his words in 1835.
rows.translation: John Newton skrev texten 1779. Melodin New Britain trycktes först 1829 och förenades med hans text 1835.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-amazing-grace “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The high line: up to D at fret 3 on string 2, then B G, B A, G E D.
rows.translation: Den höga raden: upp till D på band 3 på sträng 2, sedan B G, B A, G E D.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-amazing-grace “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: One tune, two countries
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Samuel Francis Smith wrote these American words in 1831, to a tune Britain already sang as God Save the King.
rows.translation: Samuel Francis Smith skrev den amerikanska texten 1831 till en melodi som britterna redan sjöng som God Save the King.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A dot makes a note half again as long. In bar two, F sharp rings for a beat and a half, G slips in on the and of two, and A lands on three.
rows.translation: En punkt förlänger en ton med halva dess värde. I andra takten klingar Fiss ett och ett halvt slag, G kommer på och efter två och A landar på tre.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The last line: B C B A G, then B C D, up to open E, and down C B A G.
rows.translation: Sista raden: B C B A G, sedan B C D, upp till öppet E och ned C B A G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-my-country “My Country, 'Tis of Thee” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A Shaker dance song
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Joseph Brackett wrote Simple Gifts in 1848 for the Shakers, who danced as they sang. Aaron Copland later built part of his ballet Appalachian Spring around it.
rows.translation: Joseph Brackett skrev Simple Gifts 1848 för shaker-rörelsen, som dansade medan de sjöng. Aaron Copland byggde senare en del av baletten Appalachian Spring runt den.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The second part starts high: G at fret 3 on string 1, then E D, and E F E D C.
rows.translation: Andra delen börjar högt: G på band 3 på sträng 1, sedan E D och E F E D C.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Two notes share each beat in this tune. How do you count them?
rows.translation: Två toner delar varje slag i melodin. Hur räknar du dem?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One-and, two-and
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: One, two, three
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: One-e-and-a
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two even notes per beat are eighth notes. Say the number on the first and "and" on the second.
rows.translation: Två jämna toner per slag är åttondelar. Säg siffran på den första och ”och” på den andra.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · song song-simple-gifts “Simple Gifts” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Americana medley
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · title

rows.source: Four songs, one sitting
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: the four songs from this unit, each a little faster than before. Three of them sway in three. Simple Gifts dances in four.
rows.translation: Inget nytt: enhetens fyra låtar, lite snabbare än förut. Tre gungar i tretakt. Simple Gifts dansar i fyrtakt.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does a dot after a note do?
rows.translation: Vad gör en punkt efter en not?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Makes it half again as long
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Makes it short and detached
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Raises it one fret
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts a beat and a half. The note after it is usually quick, to fill out the beat.
rows.translation: En punkterad fjärdedel varar ett och ett halvt slag. Tonen efter är oftast snabb för att fylla ut slaget.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 4 · challenge song-medley-americana “Americana medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Holiday and celebration
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 “Holiday and celebration” · title

rows.source: Carols and a New Year's song, in two, three, four and six.
rows.translation: Julsånger och en nyårssång i två, tre, fyra och sex.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 “Holiday and celebration” · unit summary

rows.source: A spring song turned carol
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This tune was printed in 1582 in Piae Cantiones, a songbook from Finland, as a song about spring. John Mason Neale gave it Christmas words in 1853.
rows.translation: Melodin trycktes 1582 i Piae Cantiones, en sångbok från Finland, som en vårsång. John Mason Neale gav den jultext 1853.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The last line climbs from open D on string 4: E, F sharp at fret 4, open G, then A.
rows.translation: Sista raden klättrar från öppet D på sträng 4: E, Fiss på band 4, öppet G, sedan A.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then from D at fret 3 on string 2, step down to G, touch C, and land on G.
rows.translation: Gå sedan från D på band 3 på sträng 2 stegvis ned till G, rör C och landa på G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-good-king-wenceslas “Good King Wenceslas” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A Welsh New Year's tune
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Deck the Halls comes from Nos Galan, a Welsh New Year's Eve song from the 1700s. The English words came in 1862.
rows.translation: Deck the Halls kommer från Nos Galan, en walesisk nyårsaftonssång från 1700-talet. Den engelska texten kom 1862.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The third line climbs: C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, D, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Tredje raden klättrar: Ciss på band 2 på sträng 2, D, sedan E, Fiss och G på sträng 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The third line
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: A7: two fingers
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: A7 needs two fingers on fret 2: finger 1 on string 4, finger 3 on string 2. Start your strum on string 5. That C sharp on string 2 is the one the melody climbs through.
rows.translation: A7 behöver två fingrar på band 2: finger 1 på sträng 4, finger 3 på sträng 2. Börja anslaget på sträng 5. Det Ciss på sträng 2 är tonen melodin klättrar genom.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-deck-the-halls “Deck the Halls” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Carolers at the door
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This carol comes from England's West Country, where singers went door to door on winter nights and hoped for a treat in return.
rows.translation: Julsången kommer från Englands West Country, där sångare gick från dörr till dörr på vinterkvällar och hoppades på något gott som tack.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2 and open string 4 are both D. How far apart are they?
rows.translation: D på band 3 på sträng 2 och öppen sträng 4 är båda D. Hur långt isär?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One octave
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Nothing: same pitch
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: An octave is the same letter, eight steps higher or lower. The two Ds blend, but one sounds brighter.
rows.translation: En oktav är samma bokstav åtta steg högre eller lägre. De två D-tonerna smälter ihop, men en låter ljusare.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: B A G, then leap from D at fret 3 on string 2 down to open D. Then E, A, F sharp, G.
rows.translation: B A G, hoppa sedan från D på band 3 på sträng 2 ned till öppet D. Sedan E, A, Fiss, G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Traditional (England)
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-we-wish-you “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: Old long since
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-auld-lang-syne “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Auld lang syne is Scots for old long since, meaning days gone by. Robert Burns sent the words to a songbook in 1788, and this melody was printed with them in 1799.
rows.translation: Auld lang syne är skotska för för länge sedan, alltså svunna dagar. Robert Burns skickade texten till en sångbok 1788 och melodin trycktes med den 1799.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-auld-lang-syne “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The chorus reaches up: B, D, open E, then G at fret 3 on string 1. Back down: D, B B G.
rows.translation: Refrängen når upp: B, D, öppet E, sedan G på band 3 på sträng 1. Ned igen: D, B B G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-auld-lang-syne “Auld Lang Syne” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Handel's echoes
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lowell Mason arranged this tune in 1839, borrowing phrases from Handel's Messiah. It opens with a G major scale, straight down from G to G.
rows.translation: Lowell Mason arrangerade melodin 1839 med lånade fraser ur Händels Messias. Den börjar med en G-durskala rakt ned från G till G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: This carol counts in two. In bar one, G fills beat one, F sharp takes most of beat two, and E slips in at the very end.
rows.translation: Julsången räknas i två. I första takten fyller G första slaget, Fiss tar det mesta av andra och E kommer precis på slutet.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The middle repeats open B and steps up to D, then repeats A at fret 2 on string 3 and steps up to C.
rows.translation: Mitten upprepar öppet B och går upp till D, upprepar sedan A på band 2 på sträng 3 och går upp till C.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-joy-to-the-world “Joy to the World” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Silent Night
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · title

rows.source: First sung with a guitar
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Franz Xaver Gruber wrote Silent Night in 1818 for Christmas Eve in Oberndorf, Austria. At its first performance, the only accompaniment was a guitar.
rows.translation: Franz Xaver Gruber skrev Stilla natt 1818 för julafton i Oberndorf i Österrike. Vid första framförandet var en gitarr det enda ackompanjemanget.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Six eighths to a bar
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, grouped one-two-three, four-five-six. Each group sways like one slow beat.
rows.translation: Stilla natt går i 6/8: sex snabba räkneslag per takt, grupperade ett-två-tre, fyra-fem-sex. Varje grupp gungar som ett långsamt slag.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The ending climbs to G at fret 3 on string 1, rings on F sharp, then walks down to open D.
rows.translation: Slutet klättrar till G på band 3 på sträng 1, klingar på Fiss och går sedan stegvis ned till öppet D.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The D chord
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: D uses the top four strings. Finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3. Strum from open string 4.
rows.translation: D använder de fyra översta strängarna. Finger 1 på sträng 3, band 2; finger 2 på sträng 1, band 2; finger 3 på sträng 2, band 3. Slå an från öppen sträng 4.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Joseph Mohr (1818), English by John Freeman Young (1859)
rows.translation: Joseph Mohr (1818), engelsk text av John Freeman Young (1859)
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · song song-silent-night “Silent Night” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: Holiday medley
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · title

rows.source: A holiday concert
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: six songs in two, three, four and six, each a little faster than before. Feel where every bar begins.
rows.translation: Inga nya idéer: sex sånger i två, tre, fyra och sex, var och en lite snabbare än tidigare. Känn var varje takt börjar.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which carol starts like this?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8. How are its six counts grouped?
rows.translation: Stilla natt går i 6/8. Hur grupperas de sex slagen?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two groups of three
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three groups of two
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Six even beats
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 6/8 sways in two big beats, each split into three: one-two-three, four-five-six.
rows.translation: 6/8 gungar i två stora slag, som vart och ett delas i tre: ett-två-tre, fyra-fem-sex.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 5 · challenge song-medley-holiday “Holiday medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Classical themes II
rows.context: Songs · Unit 6 “Classical themes II” · title

rows.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs: rests, minor keys, a wide range and third position.
rows.translation: Två Mozartteman och två gamla visor: pauser, molltonarter, stort omfång och tredje läget.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 6 “Classical themes II” · unit summary

rows.source: A little night music
rows.context: Songs · Unit 6 · song song-eine-kleine “Eine kleine Nachtmusik” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Mozart finished this serenade for strings in 1787. Its opening leaps up through the notes of a G chord, then answers with the notes of D7.
